requirement_text: insurance and reinsurance companies are required to implement management systems that will assure correct and prudent management of the business in consideration of its nature, scale and complexity.
mandatory_action: Insurance and reinsurance companies must implement management systems for prudent business management.

requirement_text: Insurance and reinsurance companies are required to maintain written rules of risk management, internal controls, internal audits and outsourcing, to be reviewed annually, mainly in the framework of new risks identified by insurers that may affect their adequate financial standing.
mandatory_action: Insurance and reinsurance companies must maintain and annually review written rules for risk management, internal controls, internal audits, and outsourcing.

requirement_text: they should be subject to regular internal reviews every year as a minimum
mandatory_action: Conduct regular internal reviews of the control mechanisms at least annually.

requirement_text: they should be approved by an administrative, management or supervisory authority
mandatory_action: Obtain approval of the control mechanisms from the relevant authority.

requirement_text: a control system should be verified by a supervisory authority with regard to risks identified by the insurer that may affect adequate financial standing
mandatory_action: Ensure the control system is verified by a supervisory authority for risk assessment.

requirement_text: a control system should be verified by a supervisory authority with regard to risks identified by the insurer that may affect adequate financial standing
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure that its control system is verified by a supervisory authority regarding identified risks.

requirement_text: a supervisory authority should have the right to require improvement and strengthening of the management system
mandatory_action: The insurer must comply with any improvement and strengthening requirements issued by the supervisory authority.
evidence_needed: records of communications with supervisory authority

requirement_text: rules of risk management, internal audit, internal control and outsourcing should be executed in writing
mandatory_action: The insurer must document rules of risk management, internal audit, internal control, and outsourcing in writing.

requirement_text: The system should be adapted to the needs, scale and complexity of an insurer’s operations and should as a minimum comprise risk management, internal controls and internal auditing.
mandatory_action: Insurers must adapt their management system to their operational needs, scale, and complexity, ensuring it includes risk management, internal controls, and internal auditing.

requirement_text: companies were required to establish audit committees by 6 December, 2009, i.e. within six months of the effective date of the amended Expert Auditors Act.
mandatory_action: Establish audit committees by the specified deadline.

requirement_text: companies were required to establish by 6 December, 2009, i.e. within six months of the effective date of the amended Expert Auditors Act.
mandatory_action: Companies must establish an audit committee by December 6, 2009.

requirement_text: Audit committees must have a minimum of three members, including at least one independent member with accounting or financial auditing qualifications.
mandatory_action: Audit committees must consist of at least three members, including one independent member with relevant qualifications.

requirement_text: audit commissions consisting of a minimum of 3 members, including at least 1 member meeting the conditions of independence with accounting or financial auditing qualifications
mandatory_action: Audit commissions must consist of at least 3 members, including 1 independent member with relevant qualifications.

requirement_text: supervisory boards comprising not more than 5 members
mandatory_action: Supervisory boards must not exceed 5 members in total.

requirement_text: Only 24 per cent of the entities reviewed undertake regular analyses of business operations with regard to this risk.
mandatory_action: Entities must undertake regular analyses of business operations regarding the risk of abuses.

requirement_text: Supervisory board or audit commission are informed about results of the internal auditor’s efforts
mandatory_action: The supervisory board or audit commission must be informed about the results of the internal auditor's efforts.

requirement_text: businesses are obliged to set them up and supply them with relevant instruments and mechanisms of control.
mandatory_action: Businesses must establish audit committees and provide them with necessary tools and controls.

requirement_text: Whistleblowing – procedure of anonymous notification of abuses to management or the supervisory board
mandatory_action: Implement a whistleblowing procedure for anonymous notification of abuses.

requirement_text: Codes of ethics
mandatory_action: Establish and maintain a code of ethics.
evidence_needed: training records on code of ethics

requirement_text: Analysis of transactions between company and management board members and of transactions with associated entities, other than typical (operational) transactions
mandatory_action: Conduct analysis of transactions involving management board members and associated entities.

requirement_text: Analysis of links between commercial partners of a company and management board members or staff with regard to conflicts of interest
mandatory_action: Analyze links between commercial partners and management board members or staff for conflicts of interest.

requirement_text: Compliance function of an entity
mandatory_action: Establish a compliance function within the entity.

requirement_text: Analysis of corruption and abuse risks
mandatory_action: Conduct analysis of corruption and abuse risks.

requirement_text: internal auditing in insurance companies should comprise the following areas: Solvency II – contribution to the sustainable development of processes to be carried out, as well as monitoring of the extent and manner of their implementation
mandatory_action: Internal auditing must include monitoring the implementation of Solvency II processes.

requirement_text: internal auditing in insurance companies should comprise the following areas: changes – monitoring implemented projects and business programmes, with more focus on the actual effects of changes rather than conforming project assumptions to reflect the implementation of these changes
mandatory_action: Internal auditing must monitor the actual effects of changes in implemented projects and business programmes.

requirement_text: Areas of Solvency II included in annual internal audit schedules (pillar II): • management 100 • effectiveness of risk management 92 • ORSA (Own Risk&Assessment) 92 Areas of Solvency II included in annual internal audit schedules (pillar III): • external monitoring 75 • publication readiness 67 • compliance with internal solutions and financial reporting 67
mandatory_action: Insurance companies must include specified areas of Solvency II in their annual internal audit schedules.

requirement_text: Areas of Solvency II included in annual internal audit schedules (pillar II): • management • effectiveness of risk management • ORSA (Own Risk&Assessment)
mandatory_action: The organization must include specified areas of Solvency II in their annual internal audit schedules.

requirement_text: Areas of Solvency II included in annual internal audit schedules (pillar III): • external monitoring • publication readiness • compliance with internal solutions and financial reporting
mandatory_action: The organization must include specified areas of Solvency II in their annual internal audit schedules.

requirement_text: actions carried out by external auditing should be considered when planning tasks of internal auditing, in particular: scope of accounts audited, risk assessment, techniques and methods of examination.
mandatory_action: Internal auditing must consider actions carried out by external auditing when planning tasks.

requirement_text: the management or supervisory board is the authority assuring cooperation between internal and external auditing, as well as monitoring the effectiveness of their cooperation.
mandatory_action: The management or supervisory board must ensure cooperation between internal and external auditing and monitor its effectiveness.

requirement_text: audit commissions should act as coordinators of collaboration between expert auditors and internal auditors.
mandatory_action: Audit commissions must coordinate collaboration between expert auditors and internal auditors.

requirement_text: joint discussions about draft annual schedules of internal auditing and the scope of accounts examination, including risk methodology and perception to apply.
mandatory_action: Conduct joint discussions regarding annual schedules of internal auditing and accounts examination scope.

requirement_text: assessment of coordination of the cooperation between internal auditing and expert auditors, including determination of whether efforts by internal auditing and expert auditors are being doubled and, possibly, the determination of reasons for such duplication.
mandatory_action: Assess the coordination between internal auditing and expert auditors to identify any duplication of efforts.

requirement_text: verification of accounts prior to their approval, a discussion with internal auditing and expert auditors of the possible weaknesses in the internal control system identified as part of auditing.
mandatory_action: Verify accounts before approval and discuss identified weaknesses in the internal control system with auditors.
evidence_needed: discussion records on internal control weaknesses

requirement_text: joint consideration of monitoring results of an insurer’s implementation of recommendations issued as part of account auditing
mandatory_action: Insurers must jointly consider monitoring results of the implementation of audit recommendations.

requirement_text: taking advantage of the results arrived at by internal auditing and expert auditors for the purposes of an annual assessment of the internal control and risk management systems
mandatory_action: Insurers must utilize internal and expert audit results for annual assessments of internal control and risk management systems.

requirement_text: taking advantage of internal audit analysis as part of forming opinions about expert auditor’s independence
mandatory_action: Insurers must use internal audit analysis to assess expert auditor independence.

requirement_text: supply of internal audit documentation at the time of an expert auditor’s visit
mandatory_action: Internal audit documentation must be supplied during expert auditor visits.

requirement_text: supply of internal audit documentation
mandatory_action: Internal audit documentation must be supplied for 2–5 meetings a year with expert auditors.

requirement_text: on-going supply of materials during the year
mandatory_action: Ongoing supply of materials must be provided to expert auditors throughout the year.

requirement_text: tripartite meetings – internal auditor, expert auditor and audit commission
mandatory_action: Tripartite meetings must be held involving the internal auditor, expert auditor, and audit commission.

requirement_text: consultation about scheduled audits at meetings between the expert and internal auditors
mandatory_action: Consultations about scheduled audits must occur at meetings between expert and internal auditors.

requirement_text: expert auditor reports observations on areas subject to audit schedule
mandatory_action: Expert auditors must report observations on areas subject to the audit schedule.

requirement_text: expert auditor presents their own evaluation of major risks
mandatory_action: Expert auditors must present their evaluations of major risks.

requirement_text: cooperation between expert auditor and internal audit must be more efficient
mandatory_action: The organization must ensure that cooperation between the expert auditor and internal audit is improved.

requirement_text: opinion on cooperation of expert auditor and internal audit is submitted to management board
mandatory_action: The organization must submit the opinion on cooperation between the expert auditor and internal audit to the management board.

requirement_text: opinion on cooperation of expert auditor and internal audit is submitted to audit commission
mandatory_action: The organization must submit the opinion on cooperation between the expert auditor and internal audit to the audit commission.

requirement_text: development of internal audit schedules by expert auditors
mandatory_action: Expert auditors must develop internal audit schedules.

requirement_text: consultation about scheduled audits at meetings between the expert and internal auditors
mandatory_action: Scheduled audits must be discussed in meetings between expert and internal auditors.

requirement_text: expert auditor reports observations on areas subject to audit schedule
mandatory_action: Expert auditors must report observations on areas included in the audit schedule.

requirement_text: expert auditor presents their own evaluation of major risks
mandatory_action: Expert auditors must present their evaluation of major risks.

requirement_text: cooperation between expert auditor and internal audit must be more efficient
mandatory_action: The organization must ensure that cooperation between expert auditors and internal audit is improved.

requirement_text: opinion on cooperation of expert auditor and internal audit is submitted to management board
mandatory_action: The organization must submit the opinion on cooperation between expert auditor and internal audit to the management board.

requirement_text: opinion on cooperation of expert auditor and internal audit is submitted to audit commission
mandatory_action: The organization must submit the opinion on cooperation between expert auditor and internal audit to the audit commission.

requirement_text: insurers not only to have their accounting policies and accounts verified by expert auditors (external – financial auditing), but also to implement internal auditing and audit committees
mandatory_action: Insurers must implement internal auditing and audit committees and have their accounting policies verified by expert auditors.

requirement_text: Timely and accurate disclosure on all material matters regarding the reinsurance undertaking, including the financial situation, performance, ownership and governance arrangements, is part of a corporate governance framework.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must ensure timely and accurate disclosure of all material matters.

requirement_text: Corporate governance also includes compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must comply with all legal and regulatory requirements.

requirement_text: The Financial Regulator expects the responsibilities of the reinsurance undertaking’s corporate governance regime to be closely integrated into the day-to-day management process of the reinsurance undertaking.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must integrate their corporate governance responsibilities into daily management processes.

requirement_text: The reinsurance undertaking is required to demonstrate to the Financial Regulator the fitness and probity of directors and key management in accordance with the procedures set out in Consultation Paper 11 (Consultation on the Fit and Proper Test).
mandatory_action: Demonstrate the fitness and probity of directors and key management to the Financial Regulator.
evidence_needed: documentation illustrating knowledge, experience, skills and integrity

requirement_text: reinsurance undertakings will be required to have corporate governance structures and internal governance mechanisms in place which are commensurate with the guidance laid out in herein by no later than 12 calendar months from the date of publication of the final guidance issued by the Financial Regulator.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must establish corporate governance structures and internal governance mechanisms within 12 months of final guidance publication.

requirement_text: In the case of a reinsurance undertaking whose registered office is located in the State, its head office or ultimate decision-making organs shall also be in the State.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must ensure their head office or ultimate decision-making organs are located in the same State as their registered office.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors is responsible for setting out the corporate governance principles that will apply to the reinsurance undertaking.
mandatory_action: The Board must establish corporate governance principles for the reinsurance undertaking.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors is responsible for ensuring that the reinsurance undertaking is run in a manner consistent with those principles.
mandatory_action: The Board must ensure the reinsurance undertaking operates in accordance with established governance principles.

requirement_text: The Directors should formally establish the risk appetite of the reinsurance undertaking, commensurate with its capital strength and ensure that the business undertaken by the firm is consistent with the agreed risk appetite.
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must establish and maintain a formal risk appetite aligned with capital strength.

requirement_text: Any material change to the formal risk appetite of the reinsurance undertaking should be notified to the Financial Regulator.
mandatory_action: Notify the Financial Regulator of any material changes to the risk appetite.

requirement_text: Set out the corporate governance principles appropriate to the reinsurance undertaking.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must establish corporate governance principles.

requirement_text: Set out its specific responsibilities and commitments in respect to those principles.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must define its specific responsibilities and commitments regarding corporate governance principles.

requirement_text: Have thorough knowledge, skills, experience and commitment to oversee the reinsurance undertaking effectively.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must ensure that its governance body possesses the necessary knowledge, skills, experience, and commitment.

requirement_text: Adherence to the policies and strategies must be reviewed regularly, and at least annually.
mandatory_action: The organization must review adherence to policies and strategies at least annually.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors has in place and monitors independent risk management functions that monitor the risks related to the type of business undertaken.
mandatory_action: The Board must ensure independent risk management functions are established and monitored.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors establishes audit functions, actuarial functions, strong internal controls and applicable checks and balances.
mandatory_action: The Board must establish audit and actuarial functions along with strong internal controls.

requirement_text: The reinsurance undertaking must demonstrate that it has an on-going, appropriate and effective process of ensuring adherence to those standards.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must implement a process to ensure adherence to established standards of business conduct and ethical behaviour.

requirement_text: Establish procedures for the appointment, disciplinary procedures and dismissal of senior management.
mandatory_action: Establish and maintain procedures for senior management appointments and dismissals.

requirement_text: The remuneration policy must be made available to the Financial Regulator on request.
mandatory_action: Ensure the remuneration policy is accessible to the Financial Regulator upon request.

requirement_text: Collectively ensure that the reinsurance undertaking complies with all relevant laws, regulations and any established codes of conduct.
mandatory_action: Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors identifies a Compliance Officer with responsibility for monitoring compliance with relevant legislation and required standards of business conduct and who reports to the Board of Directors at regular intervals to enable the Board to ensure compliance.
mandatory_action: Identify a Compliance Officer to monitor compliance and report to the Board regularly.

requirement_text: Communicate and meet with the Financial Regulator as deemed appropriate, as required or when requested.
mandatory_action: The organization must communicate and meet with the Financial Regulator as necessary.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors may establish committees with specific responsibilities such as a compliance committee, compensation committee, or risk management committee.
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must establish necessary committees to ensure prudent management of the reinsurance undertaking.

requirement_text: The Financial Regulator considers the existence of an audit committee to be an essential element of an effective control environment.
mandatory_action: The organization must have an audit committee in place.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors should have a minimum of two independent Non-Executive Directors.
mandatory_action: Ensure the Board of Directors includes at least two independent Non-Executive Directors.

requirement_text: The balance between executive and independent non-executive directors must be evidenced by the composition of the members of the Board of Directors present and eligible to vote at each Board of Directors meeting.
mandatory_action: Document the composition of the Board of Directors at each meeting to demonstrate the balance between executive and independent non-executive directors.

requirement_text: Each member of the Board of Directors should have sufficient time to devote to the role of director of a reinsurance undertaking.
mandatory_action: Ensure that each Board member has sufficient time for their role.

requirement_text: Each independent non-executive director should ensure that they have adequate time to give to the role.
mandatory_action: Independent non-executive directors must confirm they have adequate time for their role.

requirement_text: On an individual basis, directors should not participate in any decision making/discussion where a conflict of interest exists.
mandatory_action: Directors must refrain from participating in decisions where a conflict of interest is present.

requirement_text: there should be a sufficient number of Independent Non-Executive Directors to ensure that the independent element of the Board of Directors can be effective, subject to a minimum of two.
mandatory_action: Ensure a minimum of two Independent Non-Executive Directors are on the Board of Directors.

requirement_text: Except for a captive reinsurance undertaking, the Financial Regulator requires that all other reinsurance undertakings directly employ a designated senior manager responsible
mandatory_action: All reinsurance undertakings must directly employ a designated senior manager, unless they are a captive reinsurance undertaking.

requirement_text: the Financial Regulator requires that all other reinsurance undertakings directly employ a designated senior manager responsible for the overall prudent and efficient operation of the business of the reinsurance undertaking, herein referred to as a General Manager.
mandatory_action: All reinsurance undertakings must directly employ a designated General Manager.

requirement_text: It is the responsibility of the Board of Directors to develop a strong internal control culture within its organisation.
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must develop a strong internal control culture.

requirement_text: Internal controls should be designed to ensure and demonstrate that the firm is being operated within the parameters set by the Board of Directors.
mandatory_action: Internal controls must be designed to operate within the parameters set by the Board.

requirement_text: The onus will be on the Board of Directors to ensure that such systems are applicable to the reinsurance undertaking and that such systems meet their ongoing corporate governance duties and responsibilities.
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must ensure that oversight and reporting systems are applicable and meet corporate governance duties.

requirement_text: The Financial Regulator will review the internal controls and will check their adequacy to the nature and the scale of the business.
mandatory_action: The organization must ensure that internal controls are adequate for the nature and scale of the business.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors is ultimately responsible for establishing and maintaining an effective internal control system.
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must establish and maintain an effective internal control system.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors must provide suitable prudential oversight and establish a risk management system that includes setting and monitoring policies so that all major risks are identified, measured, monitored and controlled on an on-going basis.
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must establish a risk management system for ongoing risk oversight.

requirement_text: The Financial Regulator must be satisfied that comprehensive risk management systems commensurate with the nature, scale and complexity of all the reinsurance undertaking’s activities are in place, incorporating continuous measuring, monitoring and controlling of risk, accurate and reliable management information systems, timely management reporting and thorough audit and control procedures.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must implement comprehensive risk management systems that meet regulatory standards.

requirement_text: Board of Directors receive regular reporting on the effectiveness of the internal controls;
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must receive regular reports on internal control effectiveness.

requirement_text: Any identified weakness should be reported to the Board of Directors as soon as detected and appropriate action taken;
mandatory_action: Identified weaknesses must be reported to the Board immediately and appropriate actions must be taken.

requirement_text: The internal and external audit, actuarial and compliance functions are part of the framework for internal control, and must test adherence to the internal controls as well as to applicable laws and regulations;
mandatory_action: Internal and external audit, actuarial, and compliance functions must test adherence to internal controls and applicable laws.

requirement_text: actuarial reports be made to the board and to management and be made available to the Financial Regulator upon request;
mandatory_action: Actuarial reports must be submitted to the board, management, and the Financial Regulator when requested.
evidence_needed: communication records with the Financial Regulator

requirement_text: There are controls, including oversight and clear accountability for all outsourced functions as if these functions were performed internally and subject to the normal standards of internal controls.
mandatory_action: Implement controls and oversight for all outsourced functions equivalent to internal standards.

requirement_text: Policies should be in place identifying the lines of business and types of risks to be assumed by the reinsurance undertaking by geographical area.
mandatory_action: Establish policies identifying lines of business and types of risks by geographical area.

requirement_text: Appropriate procedures for implementing and monitoring the policies should be established.
mandatory_action: Establish procedures for implementing and monitoring the identified policies.

requirement_text: Appropriate procedures for implementing and monitoring the policies should be established.
mandatory_action: Establish appropriate procedures for implementing and monitoring policies.

requirement_text: The underwriting guidelines should, where appropriate, require the reinsurance undertaking to obtain sufficient information on the cedants with whom it deals to assess their integrity, management and business policy.
mandatory_action: Ensure underwriting guidelines require obtaining sufficient information on cedants.

requirement_text: The reinsurance undertaking should identify, monitor, and measure any concentration of risk on the underlying lines of business and on the portfolio as a whole due to one and the same event.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must identify, monitor, and measure concentration of risk.

requirement_text: It should set limits on the whole portfolio and, where appropriate, per line of business to limit the effect of a situation where several lines are hit by the same event or the same underlying cause.
mandatory_action: Limits must be set on the portfolio and per line of business to manage risk concentration.

requirement_text: Where necessary, there should be risk assessment models for catastrophes.
mandatory_action: Risk assessment models for catastrophes must be established where necessary.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should have policies and procedures in place for establishing technical provisions.
mandatory_action: Policies and procedures for establishing technical provisions must be implemented.

requirement_text: The Financial Regulator will require a Statement of Actuarial Opinion (“SAO”) for reinsurance undertakings.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must obtain a Statement of Actuarial Opinion as required by the Financial Regulator.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should define and document their strategy for retrocession management.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must define and document their strategy for retrocession management.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should identify the procedures for the retrocession to be purchased.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must identify the procedures for the retrocession to be purchased.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should identify how retrocessionaires will be selected, including how to assess their security.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must identify how retrocessionaires will be selected and how to assess their security.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should identify any limits on retrocession to any one retrocessionaire.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must identify any limits on retrocession to any one retrocessionaire.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should identify what collateral, if any, is required at any given time.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must identify what collateral is required at any given time.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should identify how the retrocession programme will be monitored (i.e. the reporting and internal control systems).
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must identify how the retrocession programme will be monitored.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should identify, monitor and control any special retrocessional contract conditions, such as aggregates, that will affect the amount recoverable from a retrocessionaire.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must identify, monitor, and control special retrocessional contract conditions.

requirement_text: Reinsurance undertakings should establish a process whereby contracts are reviewed and approved on a timely basis.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must establish a timely contract review and approval process.

requirement_text: All material facts and considerations (e.g. commissions, potential conflicts of interests) must be fully disclosed.
mandatory_action: All material facts and considerations must be fully disclosed in the contract review process.

requirement_text: A reinsurance undertaking’s investment policy should reflect the global nature of the business and specifically deal with asset/liability management, asset diversification, liquidity, and cash flow, considering the group structure.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must develop an investment policy that addresses asset/liability management and diversification.

requirement_text: The investment policy should have concentration limits, such as limits for investments in companies or groups and limits on investments in particular industry sectors.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must establish concentration limits within its investment policy.

requirement_text: The reinsurance undertaking should have procedures in place to monitor and control its investment policy against the limits approved by the board.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must implement monitoring procedures for its investment policy compliance.

requirement_text: The reinsurance undertaking should have procedures in place to monitor and control its investment policy against the limits approved by the Board of Directors and within regulatory constraints, if any.
mandatory_action: The reinsurance undertaking must establish procedures to monitor and control its investment policy.

requirement_text: the Financial Regulator requires all reinsurance undertakings to have an ongoing internal audit function.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must establish and maintain an ongoing internal audit function.

requirement_text: senior management, and ultimately the Board of Directors, are responsible for seeing that regular independent assessments are carried out
mandatory_action: Senior management and the Board of Directors must ensure that regular independent assessments of internal controls are conducted.

requirement_text: Each reinsurance undertaking shall give the Financial Regulator access to reports of the internal audit function of such reinsurance undertaking, as required.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance undertakings must provide the Financial Regulator access to internal audit reports when requested.
evidence_needed: access logs to internal audit reports
communication records with the Financial Regulator

requirement_text: the Board of Directors must ensure that the importance of the internal audit function is communicated throughout the reinsurance undertaking and that it has appropriate standing to enable it to perform its role effectively
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must communicate the importance of the internal audit function and ensure it has appropriate standing.

requirement_text: Internal Audit should have access to all activities and subsidiaries of a reinsurance undertaking.
mandatory_action: Ensure internal audit has access to all activities and subsidiaries.

requirement_text: Internal Audit should be able to report directly to the Board of Directors or the Audit Committee without other members of senior management being present.
mandatory_action: Facilitate direct reporting of Internal Audit to the Board or Audit Committee without senior management present.

requirement_text: The Financial Regulator would expect that the Internal Auditor report to the Board of Directors or the Audit Committee on a regular basis.
mandatory_action: Ensure regular reporting of Internal Audit to the Board or Audit Committee.

requirement_text: The remuneration of internal audit personnel must not be determined by any member of management that is subject to internal audit.
mandatory_action: Establish a remuneration process for internal audit personnel independent of management subject to audit.

requirement_text: The internal audit function should be adequately resourced.
mandatory_action: Ensure adequate resources are allocated to the internal audit function.

requirement_text: The work of the internal audit department should include an evaluation of the internal controls and a review of the adequacy of policies and procedures approved by the Board.
mandatory_action: Conduct evaluations of internal controls and review adequacy of policies and procedures by the internal audit department.

requirement_text: the work of the internal audit department should include an evaluation of the internal controls and a review of the adequacy of policies and procedures approved by the Board;
mandatory_action: The internal audit department must evaluate internal controls and review the adequacy of policies and procedures approved by the Board.

requirement_text: the internal audit function should prepare annual audit plans, compile reports on their findings, report findings to the Board of Directors or the Audit Committee and follow-up on the resolution of audit findings;
mandatory_action: The internal audit function must prepare annual audit plans and report findings to the Board or Audit Committee.

requirement_text: internal audit should be regularly updated in relation to new products offered by the reinsurance undertaking to ensure that any new risks to the business are subject to their review;
mandatory_action: Internal audit must be updated on new products to review associated risks.

requirement_text: the internal audit function should contain sufficient competence to perform an audit on any of the activities of the reinsurance undertaking.
mandatory_action: The internal audit function must have sufficient competence to audit all activities of the reinsurance undertaking.

requirement_text: Each authorised reinsurance undertaking nominate an individual office holder as Compliance Officer.
mandatory_action: Each reinsurance undertaking must appoint a Compliance Officer.

requirement_text: Each reinsurance undertaking should notify the Financial Regulator of the name of the designated Compliance Officer.
mandatory_action: Each reinsurance undertaking must notify the Financial Regulator of the Compliance Officer's name.

requirement_text: Each reinsurance undertaking should notify the Financial Regulator of the name of the designated Compliance Officer.
mandatory_action: Notify the Financial Regulator of the designated Compliance Officer's name.

requirement_text: Any change in the nominated Compliance Officer should be notified to the Financial Regulator as soon as possible.
mandatory_action: Notify the Financial Regulator of any changes to the nominated Compliance Officer promptly.

requirement_text: To obtain the approval of the Board of Directors for a policy statement on compliance with the Insurance Acts and Regulations, with requirements issued by the Financial Regulator and with other applicable legislation.
mandatory_action: Obtain Board of Directors' approval for the compliance policy statement.

requirement_text: To monitor the implementation of compliance and to report periodically to the senior management and to the Board of Directors thereon.
mandatory_action: Monitor compliance implementation and report to senior management and the Board periodically.

requirement_text: To review products, procedures and systems on a planned basis from the viewpoint of effective compliance and to advise as to steps necessary to ensure compliance;
mandatory_action: The organization must review products, procedures, and systems for compliance on a planned basis.

requirement_text: To review staff training processes so as to ensure appropriate compliance competencies.
mandatory_action: The organization must review staff training processes to ensure compliance competencies.

requirement_text: the principles set by the parent are sufficient to meet the minimum standards on corporate governance as set down by the Financial Regulator
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must ensure that the corporate governance principles set by the parent meet the minimum standards required by the Financial Regulator.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors must receive regular written reports from any service performed by the parent confirming their compliance to the standards as set down by the Board of Directors.
mandatory_action: The Board must ensure they receive regular compliance reports from the parent.

requirement_text: It is for the Board of Directors to establish the corporate governance principles of the captive reinsurance undertaking it is responsible for and not a third party.
mandatory_action: The Board of Directors must establish corporate governance principles for the captive reinsurance undertaking.

requirement_text: The Board of Directors should consider the agenda items under consideration and follow a prudent approach when determining whether a particular meeting of the Board of Directors can take place in the absence of one of the independent non-executive directors.
mandatory_action: The Board must prudently assess agenda items to decide on meeting validity without an independent non-executive director.

mandatory_action: The resolution gist must be recorded in the CRM application.

requirement_text: Grievances will be categorized as prescribed by IRDAI from time to time.
mandatory_action: Grievances must be categorized according to IRDAI guidelines.

mandatory_action: Processes for handling grievances must be approved by the Chief Operating Officer.

mandatory_action: 20 sample grievances must be shared with the MD & CEO weekly for review.

mandatory_action: Share 20 sample grievances with the MD & CEO weekly for review.

requirement_text: A quarterly report shall be put up to the management on total grievance received /resolved and pending along with a root cause analysis and category/region wise trends will be put up to the top management.
mandatory_action: Prepare and submit a quarterly report on grievances to management.

requirement_text: A quarterly report on grievances will be submitted to Policyholders Protection Committee of SBI Life Board.

requirement_text: The same shall be ratified by the Board in its ensuing meeting.

requirement_text: Every insurer shall have in place an effective grievance redressal procedure to address complaints of policyholders efficiently and with speed and communicate the action taken by the insurer on the complaint to the complainant along with the information in respect of Insurance Ombudsman as may be necessary.
mandatory_action: Insurers must implement an effective grievance redressal procedure for policyholder complaints.

requirement_text: the grievance classification and the required Turn Around Time (TAT) for resolving the grievances shall not exceed 2 weeks (14 days as per IGMS) in compliance with IRDAI Guidelines.
mandatory_action: Grievances must be classified and resolved within 14 days as per IRDAI guidelines.

requirement_text: All Customer Complaints are recorded in our CRM and a unique Service Request number (SR) is generated against each of these.
mandatory_action: Customer complaints must be recorded in the CRM with a unique Service Request number.

requirement_text: An acknowledgement shall be sent to the customer immediately on receipt of the complaint.
mandatory_action: An acknowledgement must be sent to the customer immediately upon receiving a complaint.

requirement_text: The acknowledgement shall carry the details of the grievance redressal procedure including the touchpoint details.
mandatory_action: The acknowledgement must include details of the grievance redressal procedure and touchpoint details.

requirement_text: Seek and obtain further details, if any, from the customer (permitted only once)- Within 1 week (7 days) on receipt of complaint.
mandatory_action: Further details from the customer must be sought within 7 days of receiving the complaint.

requirement_text: RNLIC shall offer a resolution within the timelines provided by Insurance Regulatory Development Authority of India.
mandatory_action: A resolution must be offered within the timelines set by the Insurance Regulatory Development Authority of India.

requirement_text: RNLIC shall offer a resolution within the timelines provided by Insurance Regulatory Development Authority of India (IRDAI) not exceeding 2 weeks (14 days as given in the IGMS) of receipt of grievance and communicate the resolution and communication in writing shall be provided seeking further information if any.
mandatory_action: RNLIC must resolve grievances within 14 days of receipt and communicate the resolution in writing.

requirement_text: the insurer shall inform the complainant of the option to take up the matter before insurance ombudsman giving details of the name and address of the Ombudsman of competent jurisdiction.
mandatory_action: The insurer must inform the complainant about the option to escalate the grievance to the insurance ombudsman.

requirement_text: The Grievance Redressal Mechanism, which is approved by the Board of Directors of RNLIC is displayed at our Branches, available in the policy documents sent to policyholder and published on our website.
mandatory_action: The Grievance Redressal Mechanism must be displayed at branches, included in policy documents, and published on the website.

requirement_text: If your Grievance is unresolved for more than 10 days Please contact our Branch Service Manager (BSM), who is also the Local Designated Grievance Officer at your nearest branch.
mandatory_action: Customers must be informed to contact the Branch Service Manager if grievances are unresolved for more than 10 days.

requirement_text: The complaint to the ombudsman can be made: If the grievance has been rejected by the Grievance Redressal Machinery of the Insurer or the complainant had not received any reply within a period of one month from date of lodgment of complaint or complainant is not satisfied with the reply given to him by the insurer.
mandatory_action: Insurers must allow complaints to the ombudsman under specified conditions.

requirement_text: The Complaint has been filed within one year from the date of rejection by the Company if it is not simultaneously under any litigation.
mandatory_action: Complaints must be filed within one year of rejection by the insurer if not under litigation.

requirement_text: The Committee shall review periodically: a) The procedures and mechanism to address grievances of policyholders including mis-selling by intermediaries.

mandatory_action: The ISC must review and recommend changes to the high level IS Policy to the Board.

mandatory_action: Operational level exceptions must be approved by the respective business owner in consultation with the CISO.

requirement_text: Review, discuss and direct information security risk mitigation (which includes reporting security incidents) and ensure that risks are accurately reported and appropriately dealt with.

requirement_text: Ensure compliance to regulatory and statutory requirements related Information Security.

mandatory_action: The ISC must support the information security governance framework with an assurance programme.

mandatory_action: The Board must approve the information and cyber security assurance programme.

mandatory_action: Each functional head is responsible for implementing the security program.

requirement_text: However, the ultimate control and responsibility rests with the organization.
mandatory_action: The organization must retain ultimate control and responsibility for information security.

requirement_text: Have primary responsibility for ensuring that appropriate and adequate security mechanisms are provided in the systems and network infrastructure shared across systems and business units.

requirement_text: Be responsible for agreeing to security classification of all infrastructure components in agreement with the business owners.

requirement_text: Be responsible for maintenance of the various security tools and solutions.

requirement_text: Ensure implementation and compliance to Information Security Policies as applicable for their business units.

requirement_text: All instances of non-compliance related to Information security shall be communicated and discussed with relevant line management and CISO.

mandatory_action: The CISO must report significant non-compliance issues to the ISC for review and remediation.

requirement_text: Functional technology teams shall be responsible for undertaking regular monitoring of secure status on each system and network within its control.
mandatory_action: Functional technology teams must regularly monitor the secure status of systems and networks.

requirement_text: All stakeholders (employees, contract staff etc.) are made aware of organizational information security policies, procedures and guidelines, threat exposures etc.

requirement_text: They should be aware of their roles, responsibilities and abide by them to reduce the risk of human error.

mandatory_action: All relevant personnel must receive information security awareness training or updates.

requirement_text: Require approval/s business application/system/ network/ computing device from appropriate authority to provide access privileges for both business users and computer staff.

requirement_text: Organization shall develop baseline SCD based on OEM’s recommendations and industry best practices.

requirement_text: SCD should be reviewed for currency on a periodic basis by Information Security Team.
mandatory_action: The Information Security Team must review the SCD for currency periodically.

mandatory_action: Formal exceptions to SCD configurations must be approved after a risk assessment.

mandatory_action: Conduct periodic configuration reviews and vulnerability assessments for the IT infrastructure against defined SCDs.

requirement_text: Regular scheduled assessments, such as internal and external vulnerability scans should be conducted for the IT Infrastructure including but not limited to software, applications, server, network, database, operating system, wireless devices, and other network equipment.
mandatory_action: Conduct regular internal and external vulnerability scans for the IT infrastructure.

requirement_text: All Internet facing applications shall undergo vulnerability assessments before deployment in the production environment.
mandatory_action: Conduct vulnerability assessments for all Internet facing applications before deployment.

mandatory_action: The organization must update its IT infrastructure with the latest OS and database patches.

requirement_text: Impact analysis and testing shall be performed for the recommended new patches, before deploying those in production environment.

requirement_text: For the patches causing adverse impact or non-availability of business applications, exception approval documents should be maintained for future reference and audit purpose.
mandatory_action: Exception approval documents must be maintained for patches causing adverse impact.

requirement_text: Patches for end-points may be tested in test environment before implementation on the user machines.
mandatory_action: Patches for end-points must be tested in a test environment before implementation.

mandatory_action: The organization must segment its network into zones/subnets based on function and possibly location.

requirement_text: All network devices should be HARDENED based on their respective secure configuration documents before being deployed in production.
mandatory_action: All network devices must be hardened according to secure configuration documents prior to deployment.

requirement_text: Defence-in-depth through placement of IDS/IPS solution shall be implemented to further control the internet traffic passing through these networks.
mandatory_action: The organization must implement a defence-in-depth strategy by placing IDS/IPS solutions to control internet traffic.

requirement_text: These solutions shall be regularly updated with current signatures / characteristics of threats.
mandatory_action: The organization must regularly update IDS/IPS solutions with current threat signatures and characteristics.

requirement_text: These solutions shall be regularly updated with current signatures / characteristics of threats.
mandatory_action: Solutions must be regularly updated with current signatures/characteristics of threats.

mandatory_action: Remote access must be integrated into the overall network security management.

mandatory_action: Clocks of information processing systems must be synchronized with an accurate time source.

requirement_text: Routing controls should be implemented for networks to ensure that computer connections and information flows do not breach the access control system of the business applications.
mandatory_action: Routing controls must be implemented to prevent breaches of access control systems.

requirement_text: There should be segregation of duties for approval and implementation of configurations for network devices.
mandatory_action: Segregation of duties must be established for network device configurations.

requirement_text: Adequate redundancy should be provided for network links and network devices.
mandatory_action: Adequate redundancy must be provided for network links and devices.

requirement_text: REDUNDANT NETWORK LINKS AND DEVICES SHOULD HAVE THE SAME LEVEL OF SECURITY AS THE PRIMARY LINKS.
mandatory_action: Ensure that redundant network links and devices are secured at the same level as primary links.

requirement_text: All single points of failure within the organization network shall be identified and the risks in such a design shall be assessed.
mandatory_action: Identify all single points of failure in the network and assess associated risks.

requirement_text: Where possible, failover technologies shall be in place to address network failure.

mandatory_action: Document and maintain an up-to-date network diagram, including wireless components.

mandatory_action: Collect and analyze logs from critical network devices to detect threats and exceptions.

requirement_text: Network security shall be monitored through a Security Operations Centre (SOC) to provide immediate response to threats.
mandatory_action: Monitor network security through a Security Operations Centre (SOC) for immediate threat response.

requirement_text: Accountability / responsibility for management of master keys shall be formally assigned within the organization in case of internal CA.

requirement_text: Key custodians must be made aware of their role and they shall formally acknowledge their obligations in administering the security of the keys.
mandatory_action: Key custodians must acknowledge their obligations regarding key security.

mandatory_action: Master keys must be secured to prevent any single individual from having full access.

mandatory_action: Keys must be changed upon compromise or personnel changes.

requirement_text: A formal process must exist to revoke symmetric keys/asymmetric key pairs in a timely and effective manner.
mandatory_action: Establish a formal process for timely revocation of keys.

requirement_text: Revoked keys shall be destroyed.
mandatory_action: Revoked keys must be destroyed.

requirement_text: Key backup process shall enable key recovery, but should not compromise key confidentiality and integrity.
mandatory_action: Implement a key backup process that maintains confidentiality and integrity.

requirement_text: Request for recovery of keys/key pairs shall be made via a formal process that includes approval from competent authority.
mandatory_action: Establish a formal approval process for key recovery requests.

requirement_text: Request for recovery of keys/key pairs shall be made via a formal process that includes approval from competent authority.
mandatory_action: Establish a formal process for key recovery requests that includes competent authority approval.

requirement_text: Data encryption keys – symmetric/asymmetric keys used for encryption shall be available as long as any information protected (encrypted) by the keys needs to be decrypted.
mandatory_action: Ensure data encryption keys are retained as long as the encrypted information requires decryption.

requirement_text: A public key shall be available as long as any information signed with the associated private key is maintained.
mandatory_action: Retain the public key for as long as the signed information is maintained.

requirement_text: Master keys shall be available as long as there is a requirement to recreate derived keys in the future.
mandatory_action: Maintain master keys for the duration required to recreate derived keys.

requirement_text: Keys used to generate hash algorithms shall be available as long as there is a requirement to prove or otherwise the validity of a previously generated hash value.
mandatory_action: Ensure retention of keys used for hash generation as long as needed to validate hash values.

requirement_text: Security logs shall be enabled on all critical information assets.
mandatory_action: Enable security logs on all critical information assets.

requirement_text: Security Logs generated by different systems and devices shall be collected such that linking (correlating) events generated across these systems and devices is possible and should be maintained for a minimum period of six months and meet other specific regulatory stipulations as applicable.
