requirement_text: the commissioner, for good cause, may order under the state’s administrative procedures or equivalent, an insurer to nonadmit, limit, dispose of, withdraw from or discontinue an investment or investment practice.
mandatory_action: Insurers must comply with orders from the commissioner regarding investment practices as specified.

requirement_text: An insurer’s board of directors shall adopt a written plan for acquiring and holding investments and for engaging in investment practices that specifies guidelines as to the quality, maturity and diversification of investments and other specifications including investment strategies intended to assure that the investments and investment practices are appropriate for the business conducted by the insurer, its liquidity needs and its capital and surplus.
mandatory_action: The board of directors must adopt a written investment plan with specified guidelines.

requirement_text: The board shall review and assess the insurer’s technical investment and administrative capabilities and expertise before adopting a written plan concerning an investment strategy or investment practice.
mandatory_action: The board must review and assess investment capabilities before adopting an investment plan.

requirement_text: The board of directors shall evidence by formal resolution, at least annually, that it has determined whether all investments have been made in accordance with delegations, standards, limitations and investment objectives prescribed by the board or a committee of the board charged with the responsibility to direct its investments.
mandatory_action: The board must provide formal resolution annually confirming compliance with investment standards.

requirement_text: On no less than a quarterly basis, and more often if deemed appropriate, an insurer’s board of directors or committee of the board of directors shall receive and review a summary report on the insurer’s investment portfolio, its investment activities and investment practices engaged in under delegated authority, in order to determine whether the investment activity of the insurer is consistent with its written plan.
mandatory_action: The board of directors must receive and review a summary report on the insurer's investment portfolio quarterly.

requirement_text: The board of directors shall require that records of any authorizations or approvals, other documentation as the board may require and reports of any action taken under authority delegated under the plan referred to in Subsection A of this section shall be made available on a regular basis to the board of directors.
mandatory_action: The board must ensure that records and reports of delegated authority actions are regularly available to them.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not, directly or indirectly: A. Invest in an obligation or security or make a guarantee for the benefit of or in favor of an officer or director of the insurer, except as provided in Section 6;
mandatory_action: Insurers must not invest in obligations or securities for the benefit of officers or directors, except as allowed by Section 6.

requirement_text: Invest in an obligation or security, make a guarantee for the benefit of or in favor of, or make other investments in a business entity of which ten percent (10%) or more of the voting securities or equity interests are owned directly or indirectly by or for the benefit of one or more officers or directors of the insurer, except as authorized in the [insert reference to holding company law] or provided in Section 6;
mandatory_action: Insurers must not invest in certain business entities owned by officers or directors without authorization.

requirement_text: Engage on its own behalf or through one or more affiliates in a transaction or series of transactions designed to evade the prohibitions of this Act;
mandatory_action: Insurers must not engage in transactions that evade regulatory prohibitions.

requirement_text: Invest in a partnership as a general partner, except that an insurer may make an investment as a general partner: (a) If all other partners in the partnership are subsidiaries of the insurer; (b) For the purpose of: (i) Meeting cash calls committed to prior to the effective date of this Act;
mandatory_action: Insurers may only invest as a general partner under specific conditions.

requirement_text: an insurer may acquire shares of its own stock for the following purposes, but the shares shall not be admitted assets of the insurer: (1) Conversion of a stock insurer into a mutual or reciprocal insurer or a mutual or reciprocal insurer into a stock insurer; (2) Issuance to the insurer’s officers, employees or agents in connection with a plan approved by the commissioner for converting a publicly held insurer into a privately held insurer under [insert reference to the section of the code providing for approval of a conversion plan] or in connection with other stock option and employee benefit plans; or (3) In accordance with any other plan approved by the commissioner.
mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire shares of their own stock only for specified approved purposes and ensure these shares are not admitted assets.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not, without the prior written approval of the commissioner, directly or indirectly: (a) Make a loan to or other investment in an officer or director of the insurer or a person in which the officer or director has any direct or indirect financial interest; (b) Make a guarantee for the benefit of or in favor of an officer or director of the insurer or a person in which the officer or director has any direct or indirect financial interest; or (c) Enter into an agreement for the purchase or sale of property from or to an officer or director of the insurer or a person in which the officer or director has any direct or indirect financial interest.
mandatory_action: Insurers must obtain prior written approval from the commissioner before making loans, guarantees, or agreements involving officers or directors.
evidence_needed: records of loans or investments made to officers or directors
agreements for purchase or sale of property involving officers or directors

requirement_text: This subsection does not permit an investment that is prohibited by Section 5.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not engage in investments prohibited by Section 5.

requirement_text: Loans secured by the principal residence of an existing or new officer of the insurer made in connection with the officer’s relocation at the insurer’s request, if the loans comply with the requirements of Section 15 or 28 and the terms and conditions otherwise are the same as those generally available from unaffiliated third parties;
mandatory_action: Ensure loans secured by the principal residence of officers comply with Section 15 or 28 and are consistent with third-party terms.

requirement_text: Secured loans to an existing or new officer of the insurer made in connection with the officer’s relocation at the insurer’s request, if the loans do not have a term exceeding two (2) years;
mandatory_action: Ensure secured loans to officers for relocation do not exceed a term of two years.

requirement_text: Are required to finance mortgage loans outstanding at the same time on the prior and new residences of the officer;
mandatory_action: Insurers must finance mortgage loans for officers on both prior and new residences simultaneously.

requirement_text: Do not exceed an amount equal to the equity of the officer in the prior residence;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that loans do not exceed the equity of the officer in the prior residence.

requirement_text: Are required to be fully repaid upon the earlier of the end of the two (2) year period or the sale of the prior residence;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that loans are fully repaid within two years or upon the sale of the prior residence, whichever comes first.

requirement_text: Loans and advances to officers or directors made in compliance with state or federal law specifically related to the loans and advances by a regulated non-insurance subsidiary or affiliate of the insurer in the ordinary course of business and on terms no more favorable than available to other customers of the entity.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that loans and advances to officers or directors comply with applicable state or federal laws and are on terms equal to those offered to other customers.

requirement_text: assets of an insurer are required to be reported for statutory accounting purposes as determined in accordance with procedures prescribed in published accounting and valuation standards of the NAIC
mandatory_action: Insurers must report assets for statutory accounting purposes according to NAIC standards.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire, directly or indirectly through an investment subsidiary, an investment under this Act if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the insurer would hold more than three percent (3%) of its admitted assets in investments of all kinds issued, assumed, accepted, insured or guaranteed by a single person, or five percent (5%) of its admitted assets in investments in the voting securities of a depository institution or any company that controls the institution.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their investments do not exceed the specified limits of three percent or five percent of admitted assets.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an asset-backed security if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of asset-backed securities secured by or evidencing an interest in a single asset or single pool of assets held by a trust or other business entity, then held by the insurer would exceed three percent (3%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of asset-backed securities does not exceed three percent of admitted assets after any investment.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire, directly or indirectly through an investment subsidiary, an investment under Sections 11, 14, 17 or counterparty exposure under Section 18D if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment:
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire certain investments if it results in exceeding specified limits on medium and lower grade investments.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of medium and lower grade investments then held by the insurer would exceed twenty percent (20%) of its admitted assets;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that medium and lower grade investments do not exceed 20% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of lower grade investments then held by the insurer would exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that lower grade investments do not exceed 10% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments rated 5 or 6 by the SVO then held by the insurer would exceed three percent (3%) of its admitted assets;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that investments rated 5 or 6 do not exceed 3% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments rated 6 by the SVO then held by the insurer would exceed one percent (1%) of its admitted assets;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that investments rated 6 do not exceed 1% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire, directly or indirectly through an investment subsidiary, an investment under Sections 11, 14, 17 or counterparty exposure under Section 18D if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment:
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire specified investments if it would exceed certain thresholds.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of lower grade investments issued, assumed, guaranteed, accepted or insured by any one person or, as to asset-backed securities secured by or evidencing an interest in a single asset or pool of assets, then held by the insurer would exceed one half of one percent (.5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of lower grade investments does not exceed 0.5% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: If an insurer attains or exceeds the limit of any one rating category referred to in this subsection, the insurer shall not thereby be precluded from acquiring investments in other rating categories subject to the specific and multi-category limits applicable to those investments.
mandatory_action: Insurers must comply with specific and multi-category limits when acquiring investments in different rating categories after exceeding limits in one category.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire, directly or indirectly through an investment subsidiary, a Canadian investment authorized by this Act, if as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of these investments then held by the insurer would exceed forty percent (40%) of its admitted assets, or if the aggregate amount of Canadian investments not acquired under Section 11B then held by the insurer would exceed twenty-five percent (25%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their Canadian investments do not exceed specified limits relative to admitted assets.

requirement_text: an insurer may acquire rated credit instruments issued, assumed, guaranteed or insured by: (1) The United States; or (2) A government sponsored enterprise of the United States, if the instruments of the government sponsored enterprise are assumed, guaranteed or insured by the United States or are otherwise backed or supported by the full faith and credit of the United States.
mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire rated credit instruments as specified in the regulations.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an instrument under this subsection if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this subsection would exceed forty percent (40%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their investments do not exceed 40% of admitted assets as specified.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an instrument of any one fund, any one enterprise or entity or any one state under this subsection if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held in any one fund, enterprise or entity or state under this subsection would exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that investments in any one fund, enterprise, entity, or state do not exceed 10% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of preferred stocks then held by the insurer under this subsection does not exceed twenty percent (20%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of preferred stocks does not exceed twenty percent of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of preferred stocks then held by the insurer under this subsection which are not sinking fund stocks or rated P1 or P2 by the SVO does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of non-sinking fund preferred stocks or those not rated P1 or P2 does not exceed ten percent of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire special rated credit instruments under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of special rated credit instruments then held by the insurer would exceed five percent (5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their holdings of special rated credit instruments do not exceed 5% of admitted assets after any new investment.

requirement_text: An insurer may acquire investments in investment pools that: (1) Invest only in: (a) Obligations that are rated 1 or 2 by the SVO or have an equivalent of an SVO 1 or 2 rating.
mandatory_action: Insurers must only invest in investment pools that meet the specified rating criteria.

requirement_text: Invest only in investments which an insurer may acquire under this Act, if the insurer’s
mandatory_action: Insurers must invest only in permissible investments as defined by the Act.

requirement_text: Invest only in investments which an insurer may acquire under this Act, if the insurer’s proportionate interest in the amount invested in these investments does not exceed the applicable limits of this Act.
mandatory_action: Insurers must invest only in permitted investments within the specified limits.

requirement_text: The investment pool shall not acquire securities issued, assumed, guaranteed or insured by the insurer or an affiliate of the insurer.
mandatory_action: Investment pools must not acquire certain securities related to the insurer or its affiliates.

requirement_text: The investment pool shall not borrow or incur any indebtedness for borrowed money, except for securities lending and repurchase transactions that meet the requirements of Section 16 except the quantitative limitations of Section 16D.
mandatory_action: Investment pools must adhere to borrowing restrictions as specified.

requirement_text: The investment pool shall not permit the aggregate value of securities then loaned or sold to, purchased from or invested in any one business entity under this section to exceed ten percent (10%) of the total assets of the investment pool.
mandatory_action: Investment pools must limit investments in any one business entity to 10% of total assets.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an investment in an investment pool under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this section: (1) In any one investment pool would exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets; (2) In all investment pools investing in investments permitted under Subsection A(2) of this section would exceed twenty-five percent (25%) of its admitted assets; or (3) In all investment pools would exceed thirty-five percent (35%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their investments in investment pools do not exceed specified limits based on their admitted assets.

requirement_text: Compile and maintain detailed accounting records setting forth:
mandatory_action: The organization must compile and maintain detailed accounting records for the investment pool.

requirement_text: Maintain the assets of the investment pool in one or more accounts, in the name of or on behalf of the investment pool, under a custody agreement with a qualified bank.
mandatory_action: The organization must maintain the assets of the investment pool under a custody agreement with a qualified bank.

requirement_text: The custody agreement shall: (a) State and recognize the claims and rights of each participant; (b) Acknowledge that the underlying assets of the investment pool are held solely for the benefit of each participant in proportion to the aggregate amount of its investments in the investment pool; and (c) Contain an agreement that the underlying assets of the investment pool shall not be commingled with the general assets of the custodian qualified bank or any other person.
mandatory_action: The custody agreement must include specific clauses regarding participant claims, benefits, and asset commingling.

requirement_text: The pooling agreement for each investment pool shall be in writing and shall provide that:
mandatory_action: The pooling agreement for each investment pool must be documented in writing.

requirement_text: The underlying assets of the investment pool shall not be commingled with the general assets of the pool manager or any other person;
mandatory_action: Ensure that the underlying assets of the investment pool are not commingled with general assets.

requirement_text: Each participant owns an undivided interest in the underlying assets of the investment pool; and
mandatory_action: Confirm that each participant has an undivided interest in the underlying assets of the investment pool.

requirement_text: The underlying assets of the investment pool are held solely for the benefit of each participant;
mandatory_action: Ensure that the underlying assets are held solely for the benefit of participants.

requirement_text: A participant, or in the event of the participant’s insolvency, bankruptcy or receivership, its trustee, receiver or other successor-in-interest, may withdraw all or any portion of its investment from the investment pool under the terms of the pooling agreement;
mandatory_action: Allow participants to withdraw their investments as per the pooling agreement.

requirement_text: Withdrawals may be made on demand without penalty or other assessment on any business day, but settlement of funds shall occur within a reasonable and customary period thereafter;
mandatory_action: Facilitate on-demand withdrawals without penalties and ensure timely settlement of funds.

requirement_text: The pool manager shall make the records of the investment pool available for inspection by the commissioner.
mandatory_action: The pool manager must ensure that investment pool records are accessible for inspection by the commissioner.

requirement_text: The pool manager shall make the records of the investment pool available for inspection by the commissioner.
mandatory_action: The pool manager must ensure investment pool records are accessible for inspection by the commissioner.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this section would exceed twenty percent (20%) of its admitted assets, or the amount of equity interests then held by the insurer that are not listed on a qualified exchange would exceed five percent (5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not exceed the specified investment limits on equity interests as outlined in the section.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire under this section any investments that the insurer may acquire under Section 15.
mandatory_action: Insurers must refrain from acquiring investments permitted under Section 15.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not short sell equity investments unless the insurer covers the short sale by owning the equity investment or an unrestricted right to the equity instrument exercisable within six (6) months of the short sale.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that any short sales of equity investments are covered as specified.

requirement_text: Investments acquired under Paragraph (1) of this subsection shall be eligible only if: (a) The property is subject to a lease or other agreement with a person whose rated credit instruments in the amount of the purchase price of the personal property the insurer could then acquire under Section 11; and (b) The lease or other agreement provides the insurer the right to receive rental, purchase or
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that investments are eligible by meeting the specified conditions regarding leases and agreements.

requirement_text: The insurer shall compute the amount of each investment under this section on the basis of the out-of-pocket purchase price and applicable related expenses paid by the insurer for the investment, net of each borrowing made to finance the purchase price and expenses, to the extent the borrowing is without recourse to the insurer.
mandatory_action: Insurers must compute investment amounts based on specified financial criteria.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of all investments then held by the insurer under this section would exceed: (1) Two percent (2%) of its admitted assets; or (2) One half of one percent (.5%) of its admitted assets as to any single item of tangible personal property.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their aggregate investments do not exceed specified limits based on admitted assets.

requirement_text: an insurer may acquire, either directly, indirectly through limited partnership interests and general partnership interests not otherwise prohibited by Section 5D, joint ventures, stock of an investment subsidiary or membership interests in a limited liability company, trust certificates, or other similar instruments, obligations secured by mortgages on real estate situated within a domestic jurisdiction, but a mortgage loan which is secured by other than a first lien shall not be acquired unless the insurer is the holder of the first lien.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that mortgage loans acquired are secured by a first lien unless they hold the first lien.

requirement_text: first lien shall not be acquired unless the insurer is the holder of the first lien.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure they hold the first lien before acquiring it.

requirement_text: A mortgage loan that is held by an insurer under Section 3F or acquired under this section and is restructured in a manner that meets the requirements of a restructured mortgage loan in accordance with the NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual or successor publication shall continue to qualify as a mortgage loan under this Act.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that restructured mortgage loans comply with the NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual.

requirement_text: The loan amortizes over the initial fixed lease term at least in an amount sufficient so that the loan balance at the end of the lease term does not exceed the original appraised value of the real estate.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that loan amortization meets the specified criteria.

requirement_text: The lease payments cover or exceed the total debt service over the life of the loan.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that lease payments are sufficient to cover total debt service.

requirement_text: A tenant or its affiliated entity whose rated credit instruments have a SVO 1 or 2 designation or a comparable rating from a nationally recognized statistical rating organization recognized by the SVO as a full faith and credit obligation to make the lease payments.
mandatory_action: Insurers must verify that tenants meet the specified credit rating requirements.

requirement_text: The insurer holds or is the beneficial holder of a first lien mortgage on the real estate.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure they hold a first lien mortgage on the real estate.

requirement_text: The expenses of the real estate are passed through to the tenant, excluding exterior, structural, parking and heating, ventilation and air conditioning replacement expenses, unless annual escrow contributions, from cash flows derived from the lease payments, cover the expense shortfall.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that real estate expenses are appropriately passed through to tenants as specified.

requirement_text: An insurer may acquire, manage and dispose of real estate situated in a domestic jurisdiction either directly or indirectly through limited partnership interests and general partnership interests not otherwise prohibited by Section 5D, joint ventures, stock of an investment subsidiary or membership interests in a limited liability company, trust certificates, or other similar instruments.
mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire, manage, and dispose of real estate in compliance with the specified methods and restrictions.

requirement_text: shall, to the extent that the obligations secured by the mortgages, liens or encumbrances are without recourse to the insurer, be deducted from the amount of the investment of the insurer in the real estate for purposes of determining compliance with Subsections D(2) and D(3) of this section.
mandatory_action: The insurer must deduct certain obligations from the amount of its investment in real estate as specified.
