requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under Subsection A of this section if, as a result of and
mandatory_action: The insurer must not acquire certain investments as specified in Subsection A.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under Subsection A of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of all investments then held by the insurer under Subsection A of this section would exceed: (a) One percent (1%) of its admitted assets in mortgage loans covering any one secured location; (b) One quarter of one percent (.25%) of its admitted assets in construction loans covering any one secured location; or (c) Two percent (2%) of its admitted assets in construction loans in the aggregate.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their investments under Subsection A do not exceed specified limits based on admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under Subsection B of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment and any outstanding guarantees made by the insurer in connection with the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under Subsection B of this section plus the guarantees then outstanding would exceed:
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their investments under Subsection B do not exceed specified limits when considering outstanding guarantees.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under Subsections A or B of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment and any guarantees made by the insurer in connection with the investment, the aggregate amount of all investments then held by the insurer under
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire investments that exceed the specified limits after considering the effects of the investment and any guarantees.

requirement_text: an insurer may exceed this limitation by no more than thirty percent (30%) of its admitted assets if: (a) This increased amount is invested only in residential mortgage loans; (b) The insurer has no more than ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets invested in mortgage loans other than residential mortgage loans; (c) The loan-to-value ratio of each residential mortgage loan does not exceed sixty percent (60%) at the time the mortgage loan is qualified under this increased authority, and the fair market value is supported by an appraisal no more than two (2) years old, prepared by an independent appraiser;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that any increased investment in residential mortgage loans adheres to specified limits and conditions.

requirement_text: The insurer files with the commissioner, and receives approval from the commissioner for, a plan that is designed to result in a portfolio of residential mortgage loans that is sufficiently geographically diversified.
mandatory_action: The insurer must file and obtain approval for a diversification plan from the commissioner.

requirement_text: The insurer agrees to file annually with the commissioner records that demonstrate that its portfolio of residential mortgage loans is geographically diversified in accordance with the plan.
mandatory_action: The insurer must file annual records demonstrating geographic diversification of its mortgage loan portfolio.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire real estate under Subsection C of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the acquisition, the aggregate amount of real estate then held by the insurer under Subsection C of this section would exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their real estate holdings do not exceed 10% of admitted assets after any acquisition.

requirement_text: The insurer’s board of directors shall adopt a written plan that is consistent with the requirements of the written plan in Section 4A that specifies guidelines and objectives to be followed.
mandatory_action: The board of directors must adopt a written plan for securities transactions that aligns with Section 4A requirements.

requirement_text: The insurer shall enter into a written agreement for all transactions authorized in this section other than dollar roll transactions.
mandatory_action: The insurer must enter into written agreements for specified transactions.

requirement_text: Requires the agent to enter into separate agreements with each counterparty that are consistent with the requirements of this section.
mandatory_action: The agent must enter into separate agreements with each counterparty that comply with the specified requirements.

requirement_text: Prohibits securities lending transactions under the agreement with the agent or its affiliates.
mandatory_action: The agreement must explicitly prohibit securities lending transactions with the agent or its affiliates.

requirement_text: Cash received in a transaction under this section shall be invested in accordance with this Act and in a manner that recognizes the liquidity needs of the transaction or used by the insurer for its general corporate purposes.
mandatory_action: Cash received from transactions must be invested according to the Act and consider liquidity needs.

requirement_text: The insurer, its agent or custodian shall maintain, as to acceptable collateral received in a transaction under this section, either physically or through the book entry systems of the Federal Reserve, Depository Trust Company, Participants Trust Company or other securities depositories approved by the commissioner: Possession of the acceptable collateral;
mandatory_action: The insurer, agent, or custodian must maintain possession of acceptable collateral received in transactions as specified.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not enter into a transaction under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the transaction: (1) The aggregate amount of securities then loaned, sold to or purchased from any one business entity
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that they do not enter into transactions that exceed the aggregate amount of securities loaned, sold, or purchased from any one business entity.

requirement_text: In a securities lending transaction, the insurer shall receive acceptable collateral having a market value as of the transaction date at least equal to 102 percent of the market value of the securities loaned by the insurer in the transaction as of that date.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that acceptable collateral is received in securities lending transactions.

requirement_text: the business entity counterparty shall be obligated to deliver additional acceptable collateral, the market value of which, together with the market value of all acceptable collateral then held in connection with the transaction, at least equals 102 percent of the market value of the loaned securities.
mandatory_action: The business entity counterparty must deliver additional acceptable collateral when required.

requirement_text: the insurer shall receive acceptable collateral having a market value as of the transaction date at least equal to ninety-five percent (95%) of the market value of the securities transferred by the insurer in the transaction as of that date.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that acceptable collateral received in repurchase transactions meets the specified market value requirement.

requirement_text: the business entity counterparty shall be obligated to deliver additional acceptable collateral, the market value of which, together with the market value of all acceptable collateral then held in connection with the transaction, at least equals ninety-five percent (95%) of the market value of the transferred securities.
mandatory_action: Counterparties must provide additional acceptable collateral if the market value of existing collateral falls below the required threshold.

requirement_text: In a dollar roll transaction, the insurer shall receive cash in an amount at least equal to the market value of the securities transferred by the insurer in the transaction as of the transaction date.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure cash received in dollar roll transactions equals the market value of transferred securities.

requirement_text: In a reverse repurchase transaction, the insurer shall receive as acceptable collateral transferred securities having a market value at least equal to 102 percent of the purchase price paid by the insurer for the securities.
mandatory_action: Insurers must receive acceptable collateral in reverse repurchase transactions that meets the specified market value requirement.

requirement_text: If at any time the market value of the acceptable collateral is less than 100 percent of the purchase price paid by the insurer, the business entity counterparty shall be obligated to provide additional acceptable collateral, the market value of which, together with the market value of all acceptable collateral then held in connection with the transaction, at least equals 102 percent of the purchase price.
mandatory_action: Counterparties must provide additional acceptable collateral if the market value of existing collateral falls below the required threshold.

requirement_text: acquired by an insurer in a reverse repurchase transaction shall not be sold in a repurchase transaction, loaned in a securities lending transaction or otherwise pledged.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not sell, loan, or pledge assets acquired in a reverse repurchase transaction.

requirement_text: an insurer may acquire foreign investments, or engage in investment practices with persons of or in foreign jurisdictions, of substantially the same types as those that
mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire foreign investments and engage in investment practices as specified.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of foreign investments then held by the insurer under this subsection does not exceed twenty percent (20%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that foreign investments do not exceed 20% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of foreign investments then held by the insurer under this subsection in a single foreign jurisdiction does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets as to a foreign jurisdiction that has a sovereign debt rating of SVO 1 or three percent (3%) of its admitted assets as to any other foreign jurisdiction.
mandatory_action: Insurers must limit foreign investments in a single jurisdiction to specified percentages based on sovereign debt ratings.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this subsection denominated in foreign currencies does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that foreign currency investments do not exceed 10% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this subsection denominated in the foreign currency of a single foreign jurisdiction does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets as to a foreign jurisdiction that has a sovereign debt rating of SVO 1 or three percent (3%) of its admitted assets as to any other foreign jurisdiction.
mandatory_action: Insurers must limit investments in foreign jurisdictions to specified percentages based on sovereign debt ratings.

requirement_text: an insurer that is authorized to do business in a foreign jurisdiction, and that has outstanding insurance, annuity or reinsurance contracts on lives or risks resident or located in that foreign jurisdiction and denominated in foreign currency of that jurisdiction, may acquire foreign investments respecting that foreign jurisdiction
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure they are authorized to operate in foreign jurisdictions and have the necessary contracts to acquire foreign investments.
evidence_needed: contracts for insurance, annuity or reinsurance

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments acquired by the insurer under this subsection shall not exceed the greater of: (1) The amount the insurer is required by the law of the foreign jurisdiction to invest in the foreign jurisdiction; or (2) One hundred fifteen percent (115%) of the amount of its reserves, net of reinsurance, and other obligations under the contracts on lives or risks resident or located in the foreign jurisdiction.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their aggregate foreign investments do not exceed specified limits.

requirement_text: an insurer that is not authorized to do business in a foreign jurisdiction, but which has outstanding insurance, annuity or reinsurance contracts on lives or risks resident or located in that foreign jurisdiction and denominated in foreign currency of that jurisdiction, may acquire foreign investments respecting that foreign jurisdiction, and may acquire investments denominated in the currency of that jurisdiction subject to the limitations of Section 10.
mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire foreign investments and investments denominated in foreign currency as permitted under the specified conditions.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments acquired by the insurer under this subsection shall not exceed 105 percent of the amount of its reserves, net of reinsurance, and other obligations under the contracts on lives or risks resident or located in the foreign jurisdiction.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of investments does not exceed 105 percent of their reserves.

requirement_text: An insurer shall be able to demonstrate to the commissioner the intended hedging characteristics and the ongoing effectiveness of the derivative transaction or combination of the transactions through cash flow testing or other appropriate analyses.
mandatory_action: Insurers must demonstrate the intended hedging characteristics and ongoing effectiveness of derivative transactions to the commissioner.

requirement_text: The aggregate statement value of options, caps, floors and warrants not attached to another financial instrument purchased and used in hedging transactions does not exceed seven and one half percent (7.5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate statement value of certain hedging instruments does not exceed 7.5% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate statement value of options, caps and floors written in hedging transactions does not exceed three percent (3%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate statement value of written options, caps, and floors in hedging transactions does not exceed 3% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate potential exposure of collars, swaps, forwards and futures used in hedging transactions does not exceed six and one-half percent (6.5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate potential exposure of certain hedging instruments does not exceed 6.5% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer may only enter into the following types of income generation transactions if as a result of and after giving effect to the transactions, the aggregate statement value of the fixed income assets that are subject to call or that generate the cash flows for payments under the caps or floors, plus the face value of fixed income securities underlying a derivative instrument subject to call, plus the amount of the purchase obligations under the puts, does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets:
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate statement value of specified fixed income assets does not exceed 10% of admitted assets when entering income generation transactions.

requirement_text: Sales of covered call options on equity securities, if the insurer holds in its portfolio, or can immediately acquire through the exercise of options, warrants or conversion rights already owned, the equity securities subject to call during the complete term of the call option sold;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure they hold or can acquire the equity securities subject to call options sold during the complete term of the options.

requirement_text: Sales of covered puts on investments that the insurer is permitted to acquire under this Act, if the insurer has escrowed, or entered into a custodian agreement segregating, cash or cash equivalents with a market value equal to the amount of its purchase obligations under the put during the complete term of the put option sold;
mandatory_action: Insurers must escrow or segregate cash or cash equivalents equal to their purchase obligations under the put options sold.

requirement_text: Sales of covered caps or floors, if the insurer holds in its portfolio the investments generating the cash flow to make the required payments under the caps or floors during the complete term that the cap or floor is outstanding.
mandatory_action: Insurers must hold the investments generating cash flow for payments under caps or floors during their complete term.

requirement_text: An insurer shall include all counterparty exposure amounts in determining compliance with the limitations of Section 10.
mandatory_action: Insurers must include all counterparty exposure amounts in their compliance assessments.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an investment, or engage in investment practices described in Section 16, under this subsection if, as a result of and after giving effect to the transaction: (1) The aggregate amount of investments then held by an insurer under this subsection would exceed three percent (3%) of its admitted assets; or (2) The aggregate amount of investments as to one limitation in Sections 10 through 17 then held by the insurer under this subsection would exceed one percent (1%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their investments do not exceed specified limits of admitted assets as outlined in the regulation.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire any investment or engage in any investment practice under this subsection if, as a result of and after giving effect to the transaction, the aggregate amount of investments then held under this subsection would exceed one percent (1%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire investments that would exceed 1% of admitted assets after the transaction.

requirement_text: The commissioner grants prior approval;
mandatory_action: The insurer must obtain prior approval from the commissioner for certain investments.

requirement_text: The insurer demonstrates that its investments are being made in a prudent manner and that the additional amounts will be invested in a prudent manner;
mandatory_action: The insurer must demonstrate prudent investment practices.

requirement_text: An investment prohibited under Section 5, not permitted under Section 18 or additional derivative instruments acquired under Section 18 shall not be acquired under this section.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire prohibited investments as specified in the regulations.

requirement_text: a property and casualty, financial guaranty, mortgage guaranty or accident and health insurer shall maintain an amount at least equal to one hundred percent (100%) of adjusted loss reserves and loss adjustment expense reserves, one hundred percent (100%) of adjusted unearned premium reserves and one hundred percent (100%) of statutorily required policy and contract reserves in:
mandatory_action: Insurers must maintain reserves equal to 100% of specified loss and premium reserves.

requirement_text: Investments of the type set forth in Section 30 if the investments are rated in the highest generic rating category by a nationally recognized statistical rating organization recognized by the SVO for rating foreign jurisdictions and if any foreign currency exposure is effectively hedged through the maturity date of the investments;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that investments meet the specified rating and hedging criteria.

requirement_text: the calculation of adjusted loss reserves and loss adjustment expense reserves, adjusted unearned premium reserves and statutorily required policy and contract reserves shall be based on the amounts reported as of the most recent annual or quarterly statement date.
mandatory_action: Insurers must calculate adjusted loss reserves and related reserves based on the most recent annual or quarterly statement date.

requirement_text: Adjusted unearned premium reserves shall be equal to the result of the following calculation: (i) The amount reported by the insurer as unearned premium reserves; minus (ii) The admitted asset amounts reported by the insurer as: (I) Premiums in and agents’ balances in the course of collection, accident and health premiums due and unpaid and uncollected premiums for accident and health premiums; (II) Premiums, agents’ balances and installments booked but deferred and not yet due; and (III) Bills receivable, taken for premium.
mandatory_action: Insurers must calculate adjusted unearned premium reserves according to the specified formula.
evidence_needed: financial statements showing unearned premium reserves

requirement_text: Statutorily required policy and contract reserves also shall include, in the case of a financial guaranty insurer, the amounts required by [cite sections of the code that require contingency reserves and any other reserves that are not covered by the terms “loss reserves,” “loss adjustment expense reserves” and “unearned premium reserves” for financial guaranty insurers] and, in the case of a mortgage guaranty insurer, the amounts required by [cite sections of the code that require contingency reserves and any other reserves that are not covered by the terms “loss reserves,” “loss adjustment expense.”
mandatory_action: Insurers must include required policy and contract reserves as specified for financial and mortgage guaranty insurers.

requirement_text: A property and casualty, financial guaranty, mortgage guaranty or accident and health insurer shall supplement its annual statement with a reconciliation and summary of its assets and reserve requirements as required in Subsection A of this section.
mandatory_action: Insurers must supplement their annual statement with a reconciliation and summary of assets and reserve requirements.

requirement_text: Upon prior notification, the commissioner may require an insurer to submit such a reconciliation and summary with any quarterly statement filed during the calendar year.
mandatory_action: Insurers must submit a reconciliation and summary upon request from the commissioner.

requirement_text: the insurer shall notify the commissioner immediately of the amount by which the reserve requirements exceed the annual statement value of the qualifying assets, explain why the deficiency exists and within thirty (30) days of the date of the notice propose a plan of action to remedy the deficiency.
mandatory_action: Insurers must notify the commissioner of reserve deficiencies and propose a remediation plan within 30 days.

requirement_text: the commissioner shall require the insurer to eliminate the condition causing the noncompliance within a specified time from the date the notice of the commissioner’s requirement is mailed or delivered to the insurer.
mandatory_action: Insurers must eliminate conditions causing noncompliance as specified by the commissioner.

requirement_text: If an insurer fails to comply with the commissioner’s requirement under Paragraph (1) of this subsection, the insurer is deemed to be in hazardous financial condition.
mandatory_action: Insurers must comply with the commissioner’s requirements to avoid being deemed in hazardous financial condition.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire directly or indirectly through
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire investments as specified in the Act.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire directly or indirectly through an investment subsidiary an investment under this Act if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the insurer would hold more than five percent (5%) of its admitted assets in investments of all kinds issued, assumed, accepted, insured or guaranteed by a single person.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that no single investment exceeds five percent of their admitted assets.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an asset-backed security if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of asset-backed securities secured by or evidencing an interest in a single asset or single pool of assets held by a trust or other business entity, then held by the insurer would exceed five percent (5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of asset-backed securities does not exceed 5% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire, directly or indirectly through an investment subsidiary, an investment under Sections 24, 27, 30 or counterparty exposure under Section 31D if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment:
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire certain investments if it results in exceeding specified limits on medium and lower grade investments.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of all medium and lower grade investments then held by the insurer would exceed twenty percent (20%) of its admitted assets;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that medium and lower grade investments do not exceed 20% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of lower grade investments then held by the insurer would exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that lower grade investments do not exceed 10% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire, directly or indirectly through an investment subsidiary, an investment under Sections 24, 27, 30 or counterparty exposure under Section 31D if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment:
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire certain investments if it would exceed specified thresholds.

requirement_text: If an insurer attains or exceeds the limit of any one rating category referred to in this subsection, the insurer shall not thereby be precluded from acquiring investments in other rating categories subject to the specific and multi-category limits applicable to those investments.
mandatory_action: Insurers must comply with specific and multi-category limits when acquiring investments in different rating categories after exceeding limits in one category.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire, directly or indirectly through an investment subsidiary, any Canadian investments authorized by this Act, if as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of these investments then held by the insurer would exceed forty percent (40%) of its admitted assets, or if the aggregate amount of Canadian investments not acquired under Section 24B then held by the insurer would exceed twenty-five percent (25%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their Canadian investments do not exceed specified limits relative to admitted assets.

requirement_text: an insurer may acquire rated credit instruments issued, assumed, guaranteed or insured by: (1) The United States; or (2) A government sponsored enterprise of the United States, if the instruments of the government sponsored enterprise are assumed, guaranteed or insured by the United States or are otherwise
mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire rated credit instruments as specified in the regulations.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an instrument under this subsection if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this subsection would exceed forty percent (40%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their aggregate investments do not exceed 40% of admitted assets after any new acquisition.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an instrument of any one fund, any one enterprise or entity, or any one state under this subsection if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held in any one fund, enterprise or entity or state under this subsection would exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that investments in any one fund, enterprise, entity, or state do not exceed 10% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of preferred stocks then held by the insurer under this subsection does not exceed twenty percent (20%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must limit their holdings of preferred stocks to no more than 20% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of preferred stocks then held by the insurer under this subsection does not exceed twenty percent (20%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of preferred stocks does not exceed 20% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of preferred stocks then held by the insurer under this subsection which are not sinking fund stocks or rated P1 or P2 by the SVO does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of non-sinking fund preferred stocks not rated P1 or P2 does not exceed 10% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire special rated credit instruments under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of special rated credit instruments then held by the insurer would exceed five percent (5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire special rated credit instruments if it would cause their total to exceed 5% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer may acquire investments in investment pools that: (1) Invest only in: (a) Obligations that are rated 1 or 2 by the SVO or have an equivalent of an SVO 1 or 2
mandatory_action: Insurers must only invest in investment pools that meet the specified rating criteria.

requirement_text: An insurer may acquire investments in investment pools that invest only in obligations that are rated 1 or 2 by the SVO or have an equivalent of an SVO 1 or 2 rating.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that investments in investment pools comply with the specified rating requirements.

requirement_text: Invest only in investments which an insurer may acquire under this Act, if the insurer’s
mandatory_action: Insurers must only invest in permissible investments as defined by the Act.

requirement_text: Invest only in investments which an insurer may acquire under this Act, if the insurer’s proportionate interest in the amount invested in these investments does not exceed the applicable limits of this Act.
mandatory_action: Insurers must invest only in permitted investments within the specified limits.

requirement_text: The investment pool shall not acquire securities issued, assumed, guaranteed or insured by the insurer or an affiliate of the insurer.
mandatory_action: Investment pools must not acquire certain securities related to the insurer or its affiliates.

requirement_text: The investment pool shall not borrow or incur any indebtedness for borrowed money, except for securities lending and repurchase transactions that meet the requirements of Section 29 except the quantitative limitations of Section 29D.
mandatory_action: Investment pools must adhere to borrowing restrictions as specified.

requirement_text: The investment pool shall not permit the aggregate value of securities then loaned or sold to, purchased from or invested in any one business entity under this section to exceed ten percent (10%) of the total assets of the investment pool.
mandatory_action: Investment pools must limit investments in any one business entity to 10% of total assets.

requirement_text: an insurer shall not acquire an investment in an investment pool under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this section: (1) In any one investment pool would exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets; (2) In all investment pools investing in investments permitted under Subsection A(2) of this section would exceed twenty-five percent (25%) of its admitted assets; or (3) In all investment pools would exceed forty percent (40%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their investments in investment pools do not exceed specified limits of their admitted assets.

requirement_text: The manager of the investment pool shall be organized under the laws of the United States or a state and designated as the pool manager in a pooling agreement.
mandatory_action: The investment pool manager must be legally organized in the U.S. or a state and designated in the pooling agreement.

requirement_text: The manager of the investment pool shall be the insurer, an affiliated insurer or a business entity affiliated with the insurer, a qualified bank, a business entity registered under the Investment Advisors Act of 1940, or in the case of a reciprocal insurer or interinsurance exchange, its attorney-in-fact, or in the case of a United States branch of an alien insurer, its United States manager or affiliates or subsidiaries of its United States manager.
mandatory_action: The investment pool manager must meet the specified qualifications as outlined in the regulation.
evidence_needed: registration documents under the Investment Advisors Act

requirement_text: Compile and maintain detailed accounting records setting forth: (a) The cash receipts and disbursements reflecting each participant’s proportionate investment in the investment pool; (b) A complete description of all underlying assets of the investment pool (including amount, interest rate, maturity date (if any) and other appropriate designations); and (c) Other records which, on a daily basis, allow third parties to verify each participant’s investment in the investment pool;
mandatory_action: Compile and maintain detailed accounting records for the investment pool.

requirement_text: Maintain the assets of the investment pool in one or more accounts, in the name of or on behalf of the investment pool, under a custody agreement with a qualified bank.
mandatory_action: Maintain the assets of the investment pool under a custody agreement with a qualified bank.

requirement_text: The custody agreement shall: (a) State and recognize the claims and rights of each participant;
mandatory_action: Ensure the custody agreement states and recognizes the claims and rights of each participant.

requirement_text: The pooling agreement for each investment pool shall be in writing and shall provide that:
mandatory_action: The pooling agreement for each investment pool must be documented in writing.

requirement_text: the underlying assets of the investment pool shall not be commingled with the general assets of the pool manager or any other person;
mandatory_action: The underlying assets of the investment pool must be kept separate from the general assets of the pool manager and others.

requirement_text: Withdrawals may be made on demand without penalty or other assessment on any business day, but settlement of funds shall occur within a reasonable and customary period thereafter not to exceed five (5) business days.
mandatory_action: Ensure that withdrawals from the investment pool can be made on demand and settle within five business days.

requirement_text: The pool manager shall make the records of the investment pool available for inspection by the commissioner.
mandatory_action: The pool manager must ensure investment pool records are accessible for inspection by the commissioner.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this section would exceed the greater of twenty-five percent (25%) of its admitted assets or one hundred percent (100%) of its surplus as regards policyholders.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their aggregate investments do not exceed specified limits based on admitted assets or surplus.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire under this section any investments that the insurer may acquire under Section 28.
mandatory_action: Insurers must refrain from acquiring investments that are permissible under Section 28.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire under this section any investments that the insurer may acquire under Section 28.
mandatory_action: Insurers must refrain from acquiring investments permitted under Section 28.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not short sell equity investments unless the insurer covers the short sale by owning the equity investment or an unrestricted right to the equity instrument exercisable within six (6) months of the short sale.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that any short sales of equity investments are covered as specified.

requirement_text: Investments acquired under Paragraph (1) of this subsection shall be eligible only if: (a) The property is subject to a lease or other agreement with a person whose rated credit instruments in the amount of the purchase price of the personal property the insurer could then acquire under Section 24; and (b) The lease or other agreement provides the insurer the right to receive rental, purchase or other fixed payments for the use or purchase of the property, and the aggregate value of the payments, together with the estimated residual value of the property at the end of its useful life and the estimated tax benefits to the insurer resulting from ownership of the property, shall be adequate to return the cost of the insurer’s investment in the property.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that investments meet the eligibility criteria outlined in the specified paragraph.

requirement_text: The insurer shall compute the amount of each investment under this section on the basis of the out-of-pocket purchase price and applicable related expenses paid by the insurer for the investment, net of each borrowing made to finance the purchase price and expenses, to the extent the borrowing is without recourse to the insurer.
mandatory_action: The insurer must compute the amount of each investment based on specified criteria.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of all investments then held by the insurer under this section would exceed: (1) Two percent (2%) of its admitted assets; or
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure that the aggregate amount of investments does not exceed 2% of its admitted assets.

requirement_text: a mortgage loan which is secured by other than a first lien shall not be acquired unless the insurer is the holder of the first lien.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not acquire mortgage loans secured by anything other than a first lien unless they hold the first lien.

requirement_text: Ninety percent (90%) of the fair market value of the real estate, if the mortgage loan is secured by a purchase money mortgage or like security received by the insurer upon disposition of the real estate;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that mortgage loans secured by purchase money mortgages do not exceed 90% of the fair market value of the real estate.

requirement_text: Eighty percent (80%) of the fair market value of the real estate, if the mortgage loan requires immediate scheduled payment in periodic installments of principal and interest, has an amortization period of thirty (30) years or less and periodic payments made no less frequently than annually.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that mortgage loans requiring scheduled payments do not exceed 80% of the fair market value of the real estate.

requirement_text: A mortgage loan that is held by an insurer under Section 3F or acquired under this section and is restructured in a manner that meets the requirements of a restructured mortgage loan in accordance with the NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual or successor publication shall continue to qualify as a mortgage loan under this Act.
mandatory_action: Insurers must restructure mortgage loans in accordance with the NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual to ensure qualification under the Act.

requirement_text: The loan amortizes over the initial fixed lease term at least in an amount sufficient so that the loan balance at the end of the lease term does not exceed the original appraised value of the real estate.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that loans amortize appropriately to meet the specified criteria.

requirement_text: The lease payments cover or exceed the total debt service over the life of the loan.
mandatory_action: Insurers must verify that lease payments meet or exceed total debt service requirements.

requirement_text: A tenant or its affiliated entity whose rated credit instruments have a SVO 1 or 2 designation or a comparable rating from a nationally recognized statistical rating organization recognized by the SVO has a full faith and credit obligation to make the lease payments.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that tenants meet the specified credit rating requirements for lease payments.

requirement_text: The insurer holds or is the beneficial holder of a first lien mortgage on the real estate.
mandatory_action: Insurers must hold or be the beneficial holder of a first lien mortgage on the real estate involved in the transaction.

requirement_text: The insurer holds or is the beneficial holder of a first lien mortgage on the real estate.
mandatory_action: The insurer must hold or be the beneficial holder of a first lien mortgage on the real estate.

requirement_text: The expenses of the real estate are passed through to the tenant, excluding exterior, structural, parking and heating, ventilation and air conditioning replacement expenses, unless annual escrow contributions, from cash flows derived from the lease payments, cover the expense shortfall.
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure that real estate expenses are passed through to the tenant as specified.

requirement_text: There is a perfected assignment of the rents due pursuant to the lease to, or for the benefit of, the insurer.
mandatory_action: The insurer must have a perfected assignment of the rents due pursuant to the lease.

requirement_text: An insurer may acquire, manage, and dispose of real estate for the convenient accommodation of the insurer’s (which may include its affiliates) business operations, including home office, branch office and field office operations.
mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire, manage, and dispose of real estate for their business operations as permitted.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under Subsection A of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment, the aggregate amount of all investments then held by the insurer under Subsection A of this section would exceed: (a) One percent (1%) of its admitted assets in mortgage loans covering any one secured location;
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their aggregate investments do not exceed one percent of admitted assets in mortgage loans for any single secured location.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under Subsection B of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment and any outstanding guarantees made by the insurer in connection with the investment, the aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under Subsection B of this section plus the guarantees then outstanding would exceed:
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of investments under Subsection B and any outstanding guarantees does not exceed specified limits.

requirement_text: One percent (1%) of its admitted assets in any one parcel or group of contiguous parcels of real estate, except that this limitation shall not apply to that portion of real estate used for the direct provision of health care services by an insurer whose insurance premiums and required statutory reserves for accident and health insurance constitute at least ninety-five percent (95%) of total premium considerations or total statutory required reserves, respectively.
mandatory_action: Insurers must limit investments in real estate to one percent of admitted assets, with exceptions for certain health care-related properties.

requirement_text: The lesser of ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets or forty percent (40%) of its surplus as regards policyholders in the aggregate, except for an insurer whose insurance premiums and required statutory reserves for accident and health insurance constitute at least ninety-five percent (95%) of total premium considerations or total statutory required reserves.
mandatory_action: Insurers must limit aggregate investments to the lesser of ten percent of admitted assets or forty percent of surplus as regards policyholders, with exceptions for certain insurers.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment under Subsection A or B of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the investment and any guarantees it has made in connection with the investment, the aggregate amount of all investments then held by the insurer under Subsections A and B of this section plus the guarantees then outstanding would exceed twenty-five percent (25%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the total of all investments under Subsections A and B, including guarantees, does not exceed 25% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire real estate under Subsection C of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the acquisition, the aggregate amount of all real estate then held by the insurer under Subsection C of this section would exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their real estate acquisitions do not exceed 10% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The insurer’s board of directors shall adopt a written plan that is consistent with the requirements of the written plan in Section 4A that specifies guidelines and objectives to be followed.
mandatory_action: The board of directors must adopt a written plan for securities transactions.

requirement_text: The insurer shall enter into a written agreement for all transactions authorized in this section other than dollar roll transactions.
mandatory_action: The insurer must enter into written agreements for specified transactions.

requirement_text: The written agreement shall require that each transaction terminate no more than one year from its inception or upon the earlier demand of the insurer.
mandatory_action: The written agreement must stipulate transaction termination conditions.

requirement_text: The agreement shall be with the business entity counterparty, but for securities lending transactions, the agreement may be with an agent acting on behalf of the insurer, if the agent is a qualified business entity.
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure agreements are with appropriate counterparties or qualified agents for securities lending.

requirement_text: The agreement requires the agent to enter into separate agreements with each counterparty that are consistent with the requirements of this section.
mandatory_action: The agent must enter into separate agreements with each counterparty as per the requirements.
evidence_needed: separate agreements between agent and counterparties

requirement_text: The agreement prohibits securities lending transactions under the agreement with the agent or its affiliates.
mandatory_action: The agreement must include a prohibition on securities lending transactions with the agent's affiliates.

requirement_text: Prohibits securities lending transactions under the agreement with the agent or its affiliates.
mandatory_action: The insurer must not engage in securities lending transactions with the agent or its affiliates.

requirement_text: the insurer, its agent or custodian shall maintain, as to acceptable collateral received in a transaction under this section, either physically or through the book entry systems of the Federal Reserve, Depository Trust Company, Participants Trust Company or other securities depositories approved by the commissioner: (1) Possession of the acceptable collateral; (2) A perfected security interest in the acceptable collateral; or (3) In the case of a jurisdiction outside of the United States, title to, or rights of a secured creditor to, the acceptable collateral.
mandatory_action: The insurer, its agent, or custodian must maintain possession, a perfected security interest, or title to acceptable collateral as specified.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not enter into a transaction under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the transaction: The aggregate amount of securities then loaned, sold to or purchased from any one business entity counterparty under this section would exceed five percent (5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of securities loaned, sold, or purchased from any one business entity counterparty does not exceed five percent of its admitted assets.

requirement_text: the insurer shall receive acceptable collateral having a market value as of the transaction date at least equal to 102 percent of the market value of the securities loaned by the insurer in the transaction as of that date.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that acceptable collateral is received in securities lending transactions.

requirement_text: the business entity counterparty shall be obligated to deliver additional acceptable collateral, the market value of which, together with the market value of all acceptable collateral then held in connection with the transaction, at least equals 102 percent of the market value of the loaned securities.
mandatory_action: The business entity counterparty must deliver additional acceptable collateral to meet the required market value.

requirement_text: the insurer shall receive acceptable collateral having a market value as of the transaction date at least equal to ninety-five percent (95%) of the market value of the securities transferred by the insurer in the transaction as of that date.
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure that acceptable collateral received is at least 95% of the market value of the transferred securities.

requirement_text: If at any time the market value of the acceptable collateral is less than ninety-five percent (95%) of the market value of the securities so transferred, the business entity counterparty shall be obligated to deliver additional acceptable collateral.
mandatory_action: The business entity counterparty must deliver additional acceptable collateral if the market value falls below 95%.

requirement_text: the insurer shall receive cash in an amount at least equal to the market value of the securities transferred by the insurer in the transaction as of the transaction date.
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure that cash received in a dollar roll transaction equals the market value of transferred securities.

requirement_text: the insurer shall receive as acceptable collateral transferred securities having a market value at least equal to 102 percent of the purchase price paid by the insurer for the securities.
mandatory_action: The insurer must obtain acceptable collateral in a reverse repurchase transaction that meets the specified market value requirement.

requirement_text: If at any time the market value of the acceptable collateral is less than 100 percent of the purchase price paid by the insurer, the business entity counterparty shall be obligated to provide additional.
mandatory_action: The business entity counterparty must provide additional collateral if the market value of acceptable collateral falls below 100 percent of the purchase price.

requirement_text: the business entity counterparty shall be obligated to provide additional acceptable collateral, the market value of which, together with the market value of all acceptable collateral then held in connection with the transaction, at least equals 102 percent of the purchase price.
mandatory_action: The business entity counterparty must provide additional acceptable collateral equal to at least 102 percent of the purchase price.

requirement_text: Securities acquired by an insurer in a reverse repurchase transaction shall not be sold in a repurchase transaction, loaned in a securities lending transaction or otherwise pledged.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not sell, loan, or pledge securities acquired in a reverse repurchase transaction.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of foreign investments then held by the insurer under this subsection does not exceed twenty percent (20%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that foreign investments do not exceed 20% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of foreign investments then held by the insurer under this subsection in a single foreign jurisdiction does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that foreign investments in any single foreign jurisdiction do not exceed 10% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this subsection denominated in foreign currencies does not exceed fifteen percent (15%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that foreign currency investments do not exceed 15% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments then held by the insurer under this subsection denominated in the foreign currency of a single foreign jurisdiction does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets as to a foreign jurisdiction that has a sovereign debt rating of SVO 1 or five percent (5%) of its admitted assets as to any other foreign jurisdiction.
mandatory_action: Insurers must limit investments in foreign jurisdictions to specified percentages based on sovereign debt ratings.

requirement_text: an investment shall not be considered denominated in a foreign currency if the acquiring insurer enters into one or more contracts in transactions permitted under Section 31 and the business entity counterparty agrees under the contract or contracts to exchange all payments made on the foreign currency denominated investment for United States currency at a rate which effectively insulates the investment cash flows against future changes in currency exchange rates during the period the contract or contracts are in effect.
mandatory_action: Insurers must enter into contracts that insulate foreign currency investments against exchange rate changes.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments acquired by the insurer under this subsection shall not exceed the greater of: (1) The amount the insurer is required by law to invest in the foreign jurisdiction; or (2) One hundred twenty-five percent (125%) of the amount of its reserves, net of reinsurance.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their aggregate foreign investments do not exceed specified legal or reserve limits.

requirement_text: an insurer that is not authorized to do business in a foreign jurisdiction but which has outstanding insurance, annuity or reinsurance contracts on lives or risks resident or located in a foreign jurisdiction and denominated in foreign currency of that jurisdiction, may acquire foreign investments respecting that foreign jurisdiction, and may acquire investments denominated in the currency of that jurisdiction subject to the limitations set forth in Section 23.
mandatory_action: Insurers must acquire foreign investments in accordance with the specified limitations for contracts in foreign jurisdictions.

requirement_text: The aggregate amount of investments acquired by the insurer under this subsection shall not exceed 105 percent of the amount of its reserves, net of reinsurance, and other obligations under the contracts on risks resident or located in the foreign jurisdiction.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate amount of investments does not exceed 105 percent of their reserves.

requirement_text: An insurer shall be able to demonstrate to the commissioner the intended hedging characteristics and the ongoing effectiveness of the derivative transaction or combination of transactions through cash flow testing or other appropriate analyses.
mandatory_action: Insurers must demonstrate the intended hedging characteristics and ongoing effectiveness of derivative transactions to the commissioner.

requirement_text: The aggregate statement value of options, caps, floors and warrants not attached to another financial instrument purchased and used in hedging transactions does not exceed seven and one half percent (7.5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate statement value of certain hedging instruments does not exceed 7.5% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate statement value of options, caps and floors written in hedging transactions does not exceed three percent (3%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate statement value of written options, caps, and floors in hedging transactions does not exceed 3% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: The aggregate potential exposure of collars, swaps, forwards and futures used in hedging transactions does not exceed six and one-half percent (6.5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate potential exposure of certain derivatives in hedging transactions does not exceed 6.5% of admitted assets.

requirement_text: An insurer may only enter into the following types of income generation transactions if as a result of and after giving effect to the transactions, the aggregate statement value of the fixed income assets that are subject to call plus the face value of fixed income securities underlying a derivative instrument subject to call, plus the amount of the purchase obligations under the puts, does not exceed ten percent (10%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that the aggregate statement value of certain fixed income assets does not exceed 10% of admitted assets when entering income generation transactions.

requirement_text: An insurer shall include all counterparty exposure amounts in determining compliance with the limitations of Section 23.
mandatory_action: Insurers must include all counterparty exposure amounts in their compliance calculations.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire an investment or engage in an investment practice under this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the transaction, the
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that any investment or investment practice does not violate the conditions set forth in this section.

requirement_text: An insurer shall not acquire any investment or engage in any investment practice under Subsection A(2) of this section if, as a result of and after giving effect to the transaction the aggregate amount of all investments in any one person then held by the insurer under that subsection would exceed five percent (5%) of its admitted assets.
mandatory_action: Insurers must not exceed the investment limit of five percent (5%) of admitted assets in any one person.

mandatory_action: Prescribed companies must appoint independent Internal Auditors.

mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the assessment of surrounding area claims and Third Party Damage claims.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the Gross profit calculations and exclusions were enforced.

mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm the submission of reports by the surveyor.

mandatory_action: Insurers must file all products with IRDA for approval prior to offering them to policyholders.

requirement_text: All particulars of any health insurance product of Life Insurers, General Insurers and Health Insurers should, after introduction, revision or modification be reviewed by the Appointed Actuary at least once in a year.
mandatory_action: Health insurance products must be reviewed annually by the Appointed Actuary after any introduction, revision, or modification.
