requirement_text: The premium charged for health insurance products offered by Insurers, to senior citizens should be fair, justified, transparent and duly disclosed upfront.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that premiums for health insurance products for senior citizens are fair, justified, transparent, and disclosed upfront.

requirement_text: The insured should be informed in writing of any underwriting loading charged as filed and approved under the Product Filing Guidelines over and above the premium and specific consent of the policyholder for such loadings should be obtained before issuance of a policy.
mandatory_action: Insurers must inform the insured in writing of any underwriting loadings and obtain specific consent before policy issuance.

requirement_text: All Insurers and TPAs, as the case may be, should establish a separate channel to address the health insurance related claims and grievances of senior citizens.
mandatory_action: Insurers and TPAs must establish a separate channel for addressing health insurance claims and grievances of senior citizens.

requirement_text: the Insurer who has issued the chosen policy should be obliged to settle the claim as long as the claim is within the limits of and according to the terms of the chosen policy.
mandatory_action: Insurers must settle claims based on the chosen policy within its limits and terms.

requirement_text: Claims under other policy/ies should be made after exhaustion of Sum Insured in the earlier chosen policy / policies
mandatory_action: Claims under additional policies can only be made after the sum insured of the chosen policy is exhausted.

requirement_text: the policyholder should have the right to choose Insurers from whom he/she wants to claim the balance amount.
mandatory_action: Policyholders must be given the right to choose Insurers for claiming the balance amount if the claim exceeds the sum insured.

requirement_text: the insured should only be indemnified the hospitalization costs in accordance with the terms and conditions of the chosen policy.
mandatory_action: Insurers must indemnify the insured for hospitalization costs only as per the chosen policy's terms and conditions.

requirement_text: Every insured should be provided with a Customer Information Sheet as specified by the Authority in the relevant Guidelines.
mandatory_action: Insurers must provide a Customer Information Sheet to every insured as per the Authority's guidelines.
evidence_needed: copies of Customer Information Sheets provided

requirement_text: The Insurer should establish necessary systems, procedures, offices and infrastructure to enable efficient issuance of pre-authorisations on a 24 hour basis and for prompt settlement of claims and grievances.
mandatory_action: Insurers must establish systems and infrastructure for 24-hour pre-authorisation issuance and prompt claims settlement.

requirement_text: An Insurer should settle or reject a claim, as may be the case, within thirty days of the receipt of the last ‘necessary’ document.
mandatory_action: Insurers must settle or reject claims within thirty days of receiving the last necessary document.
evidence_needed: records of claim settlements and rejections

requirement_text: The Insurer should ensure that all the documents required for claims processing are called for at one time.
mandatory_action: Insurers must request all necessary documents for claims processing at once.

requirement_text: The Insurer should ensure that all the documents required for claims processing are called for at one time and that the documents are not called for in a piece-meal manner.
mandatory_action: Insurers must collect all necessary documents for claims processing at once.

requirement_text: The information that the Insurer has captured in the proposal form at the time of accepting the proposal, the terms & conditions offered under the policy, the medical history as revealed by earlier claims, if any, and the prior claims experience should all be maintained by the Insurer as an electronic record and should not be called for again from the policyholder/insured at the time of subsequent claim settlements.
mandatory_action: Insurers must maintain electronic records of all relevant information for claims processing.

requirement_text: Insurer may stipulate a period within which all necessary claim documents should be furnished by the policyholder/insured to make a claim.
mandatory_action: Insurers may define a timeframe for submission of claim documents by policyholders.

requirement_text: Every Insurance Claim should be disposed of in accordance to the Terms and Conditions of the policy contract.
mandatory_action: Insurers must process all claims according to the policy contract terms and conditions.

requirement_text: Every Insurance Claim should be disposed of in accordance to the Terms and Conditions of the policy contract and the extant Regulations governing the settlement of Claims.
mandatory_action: Insurance Claims must be disposed of according to policy terms and relevant regulations.

requirement_text: The policy document should contain: Procedure for claims submission, time lines and possible course of action, if time lines for claim submission are not adhered to along with all the claims documents required for claim processing.
mandatory_action: Policy documents must include claims submission procedures, timelines, and actions for non-adherence.

requirement_text: Penal interest provision should invariably be incorporated in the policy document as per Regulation 9(6) of IRDA (Protection of Policyholders‘ Interests) Regulations, 2002 as modified from time to time.
mandatory_action: Incorporate penal interest provision in the policy document as per the specified regulation.

requirement_text: The TPA(s) details, if any along with the complete address and contact numbers should be attached to the policy document.
mandatory_action: Attach TPA details to the policy document.

requirement_text: Every Insurer should disclose product-wise or location or geography-wise particulars of the TPAs that are engaged for rendering health services in their respective website, and these details should be updated whenever there is a change.
mandatory_action: Disclose and update TPA particulars on the insurer's website.

requirement_text: The particulars of the TPAs that are engaged for rendering health services in their respective website, and these details should be updated whenever there is a change.
mandatory_action: Insurers must update TPA details on their website whenever there is a change.

requirement_text: Product-wise cashless services offered should be clearly explained in the website of the respective Insurers.
mandatory_action: Insurers must clearly explain product-wise cashless services on their website.

requirement_text: All the sales and publicity material pertaining to the 'Pilot products' should disclose that the product offered is a pilot product and that it is a close-ended one.
mandatory_action: Sales and publicity materials for Pilot products must disclose that they are pilot and close-ended.

requirement_text: The product may be discontinued from the date of (to specify the maximum date on which the product be either withdrawn or converted into a regular product) or may be continued as a regular product.
mandatory_action: Sales and publicity materials must specify the maximum date for potential discontinuation or conversion of Pilot products.

requirement_text: In the event of the discontinuation of the Pilot product, the Insured would be provided the option of migration as per the extant applicable provisions.
mandatory_action: Insurers must provide migration options to the Insured upon discontinuation of Pilot products as per applicable provisions.

requirement_text: Insurer should keep the insured informed of the list of Network Providers and display the same on their website.
mandatory_action: The insurer must inform the insured about the list of Network Providers and ensure it is displayed on their website.
evidence_needed: update logs for Network Providers list

requirement_text: General Insurers and Health Insurers should extend to all policy holders a cashless facility for treatment at specific establishments or the reimbursement of the costs of medical and health treatments or services availed at any medical establishment.
mandatory_action: General Insurers and Health Insurers must provide a cashless facility or reimbursement for medical treatments to all policy holders.

requirement_text: Cashless facility should be offered only at establishments which have entered into an Agreement with the Insurer to extend such services.
mandatory_action: Cashless facilities must only be provided at establishments with a valid agreement with the insurer.

requirement_text: All such establishments must be licensed or registered as may be required by any Local, State or National Law as applicable.
mandatory_action: All establishments providing services must be licensed or registered according to applicable laws.

requirement_text: The administration of all health plus life-combi products should be in accordance with the provisions of Schedule II of the Regulation for Health Insurance.
mandatory_action: Health plus life-combi products must be administered according to Schedule II of the Regulation for Health Insurance.

requirement_text: Insurers should issue an Identification Card to the insured within 15 days from the date of issuance of a policy, either through a TPA or directly.
mandatory_action: Insurers must issue identification cards to insured individuals within 15 days of policy issuance.

requirement_text: The identification card should, at the minimum, carry details of the policyholder and the logo of the Insurer.
mandatory_action: Identification cards must include policyholder details and the insurer's logo.

requirement_text: Insurers should endeavour to issue Smart Cards with features such as cards with Quick Response Code, Magnetic reader to enable the TPAs and Network Providers.
mandatory_action: Insurers are encouraged to issue Smart Cards with specified features.
evidence_needed: product development plans for Smart Cards

requirement_text: Insurers should provide the benefits of cashless facility to such policy holder as if such hospital continues to be on the Network Provider list.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure cashless facility benefits are provided to policyholders even if their hospital is removed from the Network Provider list before claim settlement.

requirement_text: the Insurer should ensure that the written agreement is entered into for defined services with a certified TPA.
mandatory_action: Insurers must enter into a written agreement with a certified TPA for defined services.

requirement_text: A clause empowering the Insurer to cancel or modify the agreement in case of any fraud, misrepresentation, inadequacy of service or other non-compliance or default on the part of TPA or network provider;.
mandatory_action: Insurers must include a clause in agreements allowing cancellation or modification in cases of fraud or non-compliance.

requirement_text: Insurers and TPAs should comply with standard clauses to be incorporated in all such agreements as specified by the Authority by way of guidelines.
mandatory_action: Insurers and TPAs must incorporate standard clauses in all agreements as specified by the Authority.

requirement_text: The copy of the agreement should be maintained by the Insurer for a period of not less than five years from the date of the expiry or termination of the agreement.
mandatory_action: Insurers must maintain copies of agreements for at least five years after expiration or termination.

requirement_text: The Insurers and TPAs should ensure that only those Providers who meet with such standards, benchmarks and protocols are enrolled into the network.
mandatory_action: Insurers and TPAs must enroll only those Providers that meet specified standards and protocols.

requirement_text: Insurer should make direct payments to the Network provider and to the policyholders by integrating their banking system platform with the Network Provider or the policyholder, as the case may be.
mandatory_action: Insurers must integrate their banking system with Network Providers or policyholders for direct payments.

requirement_text: Every Insurer should provide detailed product wise guidelines to TPAs for handling of claims i.e. claim admissions and assessments.
mandatory_action: Insurers must provide detailed product-wise guidelines to TPAs for claims handling.

requirement_text: The guidelines should articulate the payments / benefits allowed or disallowed under various products that are being serviced by the TPAs.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure guidelines specify allowed and disallowed payments/benefits for products serviced by TPAs.

requirement_text: Insurers should also prescribe the capacity requirements, internal control procedures to be put in place by the TPA.
mandatory_action: Insurers must prescribe capacity requirements and internal control procedures for TPAs.

requirement_text: Every Insurer should issue detailed product specific claim guidelines to TPAs
mandatory_action: Insurers must issue detailed product specific claim guidelines to TPAs.

requirement_text: Insurers should ensure that the TPAs are not carrying out the following activities as part of the agreement
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that TPAs do not engage in specified prohibited activities.

requirement_text: Insurers and/or TPAs, as may be applicable, should endeavour to collect documents for processing claims for disposal electronically.
mandatory_action: Insurers and/or TPAs should collect documents electronically for claims processing.

requirement_text: Insurers and/or TPAs, as may be applicable, should endeavour to collect documents for processing claims for disposal electronically.
mandatory_action: Insurers and/or TPAs must collect documents for processing claims electronically.

requirement_text: Claims that are being settled should be done through e-payments by the Insurers.
mandatory_action: Insurers must settle claims through e-payments.

requirement_text: the provisions of Regulation (21) (c) (i) of IRDAI (TPA-Health Services) Regulations, 2016 should be complied in the correspondence to the policyholder with respect to settlement of the claims
mandatory_action: Insurers must comply with Regulation (21) (c) (i) of IRDAI (TPA-Health Services) Regulations, 2016 in correspondence regarding claim settlements.

requirement_text: Where a claim is denied or repudiated, the communication about the denial or the repudiation should be made only by the Insurer by specifically stating the reasons for the denial or repudiation, while necessarily referring to the corresponding policy conditions.
mandatory_action: Insurers must communicate claim denials or repudiations with specific reasons and policy references.

requirement_text: The Insurer should also furnish the grievance redressal procedures available with the Insurance Company and with the Insurance Ombudsman along with the detailed addresses of the respective offices.
mandatory_action: Insurers must provide grievance redressal procedures and addresses to policyholders.

requirement_text: Where there is a change in the TPA, Insurers should communicate to the policyholders 30 days before giving effect to the change.
mandatory_action: Insurers must notify policyholders of TPA changes 30 days in advance.

requirement_text: The contact details like helpline numbers, addresses, etc. of the new TPA should be immediately made available to all the policyholders in case of change of TPA.
mandatory_action: Insurers must provide contact details of the new TPA to policyholders immediately after a change.
evidence_needed: communication logs of TPA contact details

requirement_text: The contact details like helpline numbers, addresses, etc. of the new TPA should be immediately made available to all the policyholders in case of change of TPA.
mandatory_action: Insurers must provide contact details of the new TPA to policyholders immediately upon change.

requirement_text: The Insurers should take over all the data in respect of the policies serviced by the earlier TPA within thirty days from the cessation of the services of the TPA and make sure that the same is transferred seamlessly to the newly assigned TPA, if any.
mandatory_action: Insurers must transfer all data from the previous TPA within thirty days of service cessation.

requirement_text: The respective claim settlement files should be handed over to the Insurer within 15 days thereof.
mandatory_action: Claim settlement files must be handed over to the Insurer within 15 days.

requirement_text: Authority may require Insurers, TPAs and Network Providers, to comply with data related matters as specified in the Guidelines that may be issued separately.
mandatory_action: Insurers, TPAs, and Network Providers must comply with any data-related guidelines issued by the Authority.

requirement_text: Authority may require Insurers, TPAs and Network Providers, to comply with data related matters as specified in the Guidelines that may be issued separately.
mandatory_action: Insurers, TPAs, and Network Providers must comply with data-related matters as specified in the Guidelines issued by the Authority.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor needs to study the pricing of different types of policies.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must analyze the pricing of various insurance policies.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify whether they were supported by actuarial recommendation based on mortality ratio as well as the morbidity ratio of occurrence of certain type of illness at different age groups and cost of their administration.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm that premium fixation is backed by actuarial recommendations considering mortality and morbidity ratios.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should also ensure whether the Insurer had fixed the premium rates based on the master data available with him.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that premium rates are established using the available master data.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure whether the Insurer had fixed the premium rates based on the master data available with him.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that premium rates are fixed based on master data.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify whether the Insurer had reviewed the premium rates offered every year and made adjustments in the premium rates with the approval of IRDA.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm annual review and adjustment of premium rates with IRDA approval.

requirement_text: There should be an underwriting policy by the Insurer.
mandatory_action: The Insurer must have an underwriting policy in place.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that the Underwriting policy was approved by the Board of the Insurer.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify Board approval of the underwriting policy.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify whether the underwriting policy was modified in tune with the changes affecting the medical field and health insurance policies.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must check for modifications to the underwriting policy based on relevant changes.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether there is any change in the premium rates approved by the Board of the Insurer and when new products were introduced, they got approval from IRDA? Or atleast they were filed with IRDA before marketing the products.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify Board approval for premium rate changes and IRDA approval for new products.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the underwriting policy of the Insurer contained various underwriting parameters to differentiate different classes of risks being accepted in accordance with the respective risk categories.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the underwriting policy for compliance with risk differentiation.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether loading on premium rates for coverage of different illness or sub-standard lives were fixed.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that premium loading for various illnesses or sub-standard lives is appropriately established.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the loading was made for adding coverage to certain exclusions of policy like pregnancy, Child-delivery related expenses, glasses to eyes excluding frames etc.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the loading for coverage on specific policy exclusions.

requirement_text: the IA should verify whether such discounts did not affect the profitability of the portfolio, If so it should be critically analysed and commented
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must assess the impact of discounts on portfolio profitability.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the premium determination in case of group medi-claim insurance.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the premium determination for group medi-claim insurance.

requirement_text: Whether past history of claim ratio was taken into account? The expenses like brokerage and TPA charges were properly loaded to be checked.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm that past claim ratios and expenses were appropriately considered.

requirement_text: While allowing the discounts, the Internal Auditor should check
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must review the process of allowing discounts.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the officer in charge has adequate delegated powers to offer such discounts or got them ratified
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the delegated powers of the officer in charge regarding discounts.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the parameters fixed by the Insurer to offer incentives to the policy holders for early entry, continued renewals, favourable claims experience, preventive and wellness habits of the insured and included in the prospectus and policy documents
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must review the parameters for incentives provided to policyholders.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the discounts in premium or discounts or benefits on diagnostic or pharmaceuticals or consultation services of providers in the network were provided
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the provision of discounts or benefits on premiums and services.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether on renewal of policies, applicable premiums for the age group was applied and rebate/discounts were allowed
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that correct premiums and discounts are applied upon policy renewal.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should not only check whether the name of the TPA was clearly spelt out in the policy, but also ensure whether the TPA had provided the cashless cards within the time prescribed to the policy holders.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the TPA's name and cashless card provision timelines.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify the pre-insurance medical examination costs which form part of the expenses on premium.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify pre-insurance medical examination costs.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether, all the data required from the policy holder were captured in the application form and the Insurer had maintained confidentiality.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure all required data is captured and confidentiality is maintained.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify whether as per the IRDA guidelines, the Terms & Conditions of different types of policies or products were clearly spelt out?
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the clarity of Terms & Conditions for policies as per IRDA guidelines.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the exclusions and inclusions were clearly spelt out in the Terms & Conditions of the policies to avoid future litigations.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must check the clarity of exclusions and inclusions in policy Terms & Conditions.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the policy conditions allowed free look period of 15 days to the policy holders?
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify if a 15-day free look period is allowed in policy conditions.

requirement_text: If so check whether any policy was cancelled within the free look period without any claim and if so check the refund details. Check whether the applicable expenses were deducted out of refund of policy amount.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must check for cancellations within the free look period and verify refund details.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether any proposals were rejected and verify the reasons for such denials
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must check for rejected proposals and verify the reasons for denials.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the fixation of sub-limits applicable
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must check the fixation of applicable sub-limits.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether any proposals were rejected and verify the reasons for such denials
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify rejected proposals and their reasons.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the fixation of sub-limits applicable on any of the covers offered in the policy conditions and their impact on the portfolio on implementation
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the fixation of sub-limits and their impact on the portfolio.
evidence_needed: audit report on sub-limits and portfolio impact

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the penal interest clause was incorporated in the T&C of the policies
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the incorporation of the penal interest clause in the T&C of policies.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify whether adequate information was provided to the insured the list of network providers on geography-wise and updated the changes to provide cashless facilities
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the adequacy of information provided to the insured regarding network providers.
evidence_needed: documentation of information provided to insured

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that only IRDA registered TPAs were selected by the Insurer to administer the health policies
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that only IRDA registered TPAs are selected for health policy administration.
evidence_needed: list of selected TPAs and their registration status

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check all the agreements entered into with all the TPAs. The clauses mentioned in the Regulations should be forming part of the agreement
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must check all agreements with TPAs to ensure regulatory clauses are included.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check all the agreements entered into with all the TPAs.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must review all TPA agreements.

requirement_text: It is obligatory for the TPA to provide a copy of the agreement with network providers.
mandatory_action: TPAs must provide copies of their agreements with network providers.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the Insurer had verified the TPAs internal control system capacity requirement and adequate qualified man power to administer the TPA.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm that the Insurer has verified the TPA's internal control system and manpower adequacy.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the Insurer had entered into agreement with adequate number of TPAs to serve the policy holders.
mandatory_action: The Insurer must enter into agreements with an adequate number of TPAs.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the provision for termination of agreement with TPA/Network providers for fraudulent practices.
mandatory_action: The Insurer must have provisions for terminating agreements with TPAs for fraudulent practices.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the Insurer provided the TPAs detailed guidelines for settlement of claims and they are uniform to all the TPAs.
mandatory_action: The Insurer must provide detailed and uniform guidelines for claim settlement to all TPAs.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the Insurer and TPAs ensured that only those providers who meet with such standards, benchmarks and protocols prescribed by IRDA into the network.
mandatory_action: The Insurer and TPAs must ensure that only compliant providers are included in the network.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify that no claim is settled by the TPA and getting reimbursement.
mandatory_action: The Insurer must ensure that claims are not settled by TPAs for reimbursement.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the settlement of claims or reimbursements were to be made directly by the Insurer and not by TPAs.
mandatory_action: The Insurer must settle claims and reimbursements directly, without TPA involvement.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the settlement of claims or reimbursements were to be made directly by the Insurer and not by TPAs.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that claims are settled directly by the Insurer.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the claims to be settled through banking channel only i.e. Payment by way of demand draft, bank transfer etc., No cash settlement to be made.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm that all claims are settled through banking channels only.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the cases of repudiation or rejection of claims by TPAs and examine their reasonableness and as per policy conditions.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must review and assess the reasonableness of claims repudiation or rejection by TPAs.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure timely settlement of claims.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that claims are settled in a timely manner.

requirement_text: In cases of reimbursement, the Internal Auditor should check that the Insurer had taken due care in settlement as per terms and conditions of policy.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that reimbursements are settled according to policy terms and conditions.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the Insurer/TPA had collected all the required documents for processing the claims for disposal electronically.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that all required documents for claims processing are collected.

requirement_text: In case of rejection/repudiation of claims, the Internal Auditor should check whether the Insurer had specifically recorded reasons and intimated the policy holder indicating the relevant policy conditions.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that reasons for claim rejection are documented and communicated to policyholders.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether there is a sound grievance redressal system to dispose of the grievances of the policy holders.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that a grievance redressal system is in place for policyholder grievances.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the Insurer and TPA are maintaining the data secrecy of the policy holder on their policy and claims details.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify data secrecy compliance by the Insurer and TPA.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the Insurer and TPA had put in place adequate control systems to identify, monitor and mitigate frauds.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm the existence of adequate fraud control systems by the Insurer and TPA.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether in inward or outward ported policies, a policyholder desirous of porting his/her policy to another insurance company had applied to such insurance company to port the entire policy along with all the members of the family, if any, at least 45 days before, but not earlier than 60 days from the premium renewal date of his/her existing policy.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify compliance with the policy porting application timeline.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether Insurer will not be liable to offer portability if policyholder (a) fails to approach the new insurer at.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that the Insurer's liability regarding portability is clearly defined and communicated.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether Insurer will not be liable to offer portability if policyholder (a) fails to approach the new insurer at least 45 days before the premium renewal date, or (b) approaches the new Insurer more than 60 days prior to the premium renewal date.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify compliance with the portability conditions for policyholders.

requirement_text: Portability should be opted for by the policyholder only at the end of the policy period and not during the currency of the policy.
mandatory_action: Policyholders must opt for portability only at the end of their policy period.

requirement_text: The existing policy should be allowed to be extended, if requested for by the policyholder, for a short period of not less than one month by accepting a pro-rata premium for such short period.
mandatory_action: Insurers must extend existing policies for at least one month upon request from the policyholder.

requirement_text: Existing insurer should not cancel existing policy until such time a confirmed policy from new insurer is received or there is a specific written request of the insured.
mandatory_action: Insurers must refrain from canceling existing policies until confirmation from the new insurer is obtained or a written request is received from the insured.

requirement_text: the new insurer, in all such cases, should reckon the date of the commencement of risk to match with the date of expiry of the short period policy issued based on the request of the policyholder.
mandatory_action: The new insurer must align the commencement date of risk with the expiry date of the short period policy as requested by the policyholder.

requirement_text: If for any reason the insured intends to continue the policy before the expiry of the policy or before the expiry of the short-period policy referred to under Clause (5) (a) above, with the existing insurer, it shall be allowed to continue by charging regular premium and without imposing any new condition.
mandatory_action: The existing insurer must allow the insured to continue the policy before expiry without imposing new conditions, charging only the regular premium.

requirement_text: In case the policyholder has opted for portability and there is a claim, the existing insurer may charge the balance premium for remaining part.
mandatory_action: The existing insurer may charge the balance premium if the policyholder opts for portability and there is a claim.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the formalities as prescribed by the IRDA regarding portability is followed for both incoming and outgoing.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify compliance with IRDA's portability formalities for both incoming and outgoing policies.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the agreements between the Insurers in offering the products
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the agreements related to Health plus life combi products.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the reasonability of the premium fixed for such products.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must assess the reasonableness of the premiums for Health plus life combi products.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should exercise all the checks mentioned above for administration and claims settlements of the products of these kinds.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must perform all necessary checks for administration and claims settlements of Health plus life combi products.

requirement_text: No motor vehicle can ply in a public place without such insurance.
mandatory_action: Ensure that all motor vehicles have compulsory third-party liability insurance before operating in public places.

requirement_text: The policy of insurance shall be of no effect unless and until a certificate of insurance in the form prescribed under the Rules of the Act is issued.
mandatory_action: Insurers must issue a certificate of insurance as prescribed by the Motor Vehicles Act.

requirement_text: The insured is required to safeguard the vehicle from loss or damage and maintain it in efficient condition.
mandatory_action: The insured must safeguard the vehicle and maintain it in efficient condition.

requirement_text: In the event of an accident, the insured shall take precautions to prevent further damage.
mandatory_action: The insured must take precautions to prevent further damage in the event of an accident.

requirement_text: The insurer has the option to repair or replace the vehicle or parts or pay in cash the amount of damage or loss.
mandatory_action: The insurer must choose to repair, replace, or pay for the vehicle or parts in case of damage or loss.

requirement_text: The insurer‘s liability cannot exceed the insured‘s estimated value of the vehicle (specified in the policy) or the value of the vehicle at the time of loss whichever is less.

requirement_text: While framing the Investment Policy, the Board should ensure compliance with the following: Scope of Internal or Concurrent audit of Investments.
mandatory_action: The Board must ensure that the Investment Policy includes provisions for internal or concurrent audits of investments.

requirement_text: The investment policy of General Insurer including an insurer carrying on business of re-insurance or health insurance, as approved by the Board shall be implemented by the investment committee.
mandatory_action: The investment committee must implement the investment policy approved by the Board.

requirement_text: The Board shall review on a quarterly basis the monitoring of fund wise and in respect of each product the following minimum.
mandatory_action: The Board must conduct quarterly reviews of fund monitoring and product performance.

requirement_text: The Board should review the investment policy and its implementation on a half-yearly basis or at such short intervals as it may decide and make such modification to the investment policy as is necessary to bring it in line with the investment provisions laid down in the Act and Regulations made there under, keeping in mind protection of policyholders‘ interest and pattern of investment laid down in these
mandatory_action: The Board must review and modify the investment policy at least every six months.

requirement_text: The funds of the insurer should be invested and continued to be invested in equity shares, equity related instruments and debt instruments rated as per Note below Regulations 4 to 8 by a credit rating agency, registered under SEBI (Credit Rating Agencies)
mandatory_action: Insurers must invest their funds in specified financial instruments as per regulatory guidelines.

requirement_text: The Board should lay down norms for investing in ‗Other Investments‘ as specified in section 27A(2) of the Insurance Act, 1938 by the investment committee, taking into account the safety and liquidity of the policyholders‘ funds and protection of their interest.
mandatory_action: The Board must establish investment norms for 'Other Investments' as per the Insurance Act.

requirement_text: the insurer should clearly segregate the functions and operations of front, mid and back office and no function falling under Front, Mid and Back Office Investment function(s), shall be outsourced.
mandatory_action: The insurer must segregate investment functions and not outsource any related operations.

requirement_text: the primary data server of the computer application used for investment management should remain within the country.
mandatory_action: The primary data server for investment management must be located within the country.

requirement_text: The Board of the Insurer should appoint a Custodian to carry out the
mandatory_action: The Board must appoint a Custodian for investment management.

requirement_text: The Board of the Insurer should appoint a Custodian to carry out the custodial service for its Investments, who shall not be an entity under its promoter ‘Group’ unless permitted otherwise by the Authority.
mandatory_action: The Board must appoint a compliant Custodian for investment custodial services.

requirement_text: The Board should implement the Investment Risk Management Systems and Process, mandated by the Authority. The implementation shall be certified by a Chartered Accountant firm.
mandatory_action: The Board must implement and certify the Investment Risk Management Systems and Process.

requirement_text: The Investment Risk Management Systems and Process should be reviewed once in two financial years or such shorter frequency as decided by the Board of the Insurer (the gap between two such audits should not be more than two years), by a Chartered Accountant firm and file the certificate issued by such Chartered Accountant, with the Authority along with the first quarter returns.
mandatory_action: The Board must ensure the Investment Risk Management Systems are reviewed and certified by a Chartered Accountant firm at least once every two years.

requirement_text: file the certificate issued by such Chartered Accountant, with the Authority along with the first quarter returns.
mandatory_action: The organization must file the certificate issued by the Chartered Accountant with the Authority along with the first quarter returns.

requirement_text: The appointment of Chartered Accountant firm to certify implementation and review of Investment Risk Management Systems and Process shall be as per the circular issued under these regulations.
mandatory_action: The organization must appoint a Chartered Accountant firm according to the circular issued under these regulations for certifying the implementation and review of Investment Risk Management Systems and Process.
evidence_needed: appointment records of Chartered Accountant firm

requirement_text: Accounting of Investments shall be as per the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (Preparation of Financial Statements and Auditor‘s Report of Insurance Companies) Regulations and Valuation of Assets shall be as per guidelines issued under these regulations from time to time.
mandatory_action: The organization must account for investments and value assets according to the specified regulations and guidelines.

requirement_text: Every Insurer should constitute an Audit Committee of the Board, headed by an individual, as per the IRDAI Corporate Governance Guidelines and such person, and should not be the Chairman of Investment Committee.
mandatory_action: Insurers must constitute an Audit Committee of the Board as per the IRDAI guidelines.

requirement_text: The Insurer should have the investment transactions covering both Shareholders and Policyholders funds be audited through Internal or Concurrent Auditor as per the circular issued under this regulation.
mandatory_action: Insurers must audit investment transactions through Internal or Concurrent Auditor.

requirement_text: The quarterly internal / concurrent audit report, covering investments of both shareholders as well as policyholders, shall be as per the ―Guidance note on Internal / Concurrent Audit of Investment functions of Insurance Companies‖ issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, as amended from time to time.
mandatory_action: Insurers must prepare quarterly internal/concurrent audit reports as per the specified guidance note.

requirement_text: The Details of Investment Policy, implementation status of Investment Risk Management Systems and Process or its review shall be made available to the internal or concurrent auditor.
mandatory_action: The insurer must provide the internal or concurrent auditor with the details of the Investment Policy and its implementation status.

requirement_text: The auditor should comment on implementation status, review and its impact on the investment operations, systems and process in their report to be placed before the Board‘s Audit Committee.
mandatory_action: The auditor must include comments on the implementation status and its impact in their report to the Board's Audit Committee.

requirement_text: The Statutory Auditor of the Insurer should, on a quarterly basis, confirm compliance to Regulation 13(B)(4)(a,b) and such confirmation, shall be filed by the insurer along with periodical investment returns.
mandatory_action: The Statutory Auditor must confirm compliance to Regulation 13(B)(4)(a,b) quarterly and the insurer must file this confirmation with investment returns.

requirement_text: Every insurer should invest its controlled fund as defined under Section 27A or all assets as defined under section 27(2) of the Insurance Act 1938 as amended from time to time only within the exhaustive category of investments listed in the guidelines issued by IRDA.
mandatory_action: Insurers must invest their controlled funds only in the categories of investments specified by IRDA guidelines.

requirement_text: Every Insurer should invest its controlled fund as defined under Section 27A / all assets as defined under Section 27(2) of the Insurance Act, 1938 as amended from time to time, only within the exhaustive category of investments listed in the guidelines issued by the Authority.
mandatory_action: Insurers must invest their controlled funds only in the categories of investments specified by the IRDA guidelines.

requirement_text: Every insurer should submit to the IRDA the prescribed returns (in physical / electronic mode) within such time, at such intervals duly verified/certified in the manner as indicated there against.
mandatory_action: Insurers must submit prescribed returns to the IRDA within specified timeframes and in the required format.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should exercise such examination and certify as per Form 4B stipulated in the Regulations.
mandatory_action: Internal Auditors must examine and certify returns according to Form 4B.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should also check whether the Insurer had reported the effects or possible effects due to any extra-ordinary event coming to its knowledge which could have material adverse impact on the investment portfolio and consequent impact on the insured fund.
mandatory_action: Internal Auditors must verify that insurers report any extraordinary events affecting the investment portfolio.

requirement_text: The IRDA (Investment) Regulations specify appointment of concurrent/Internal Auditor compulsory for the audit of Investment activities by an Insurer.
mandatory_action: Insurers must appoint a concurrent/Internal Auditor for auditing investment activities.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that there is a proper Investment Committee without vacancies in it to take appropriate investment decisions.
mandatory_action: Ensure that the Investment Committee is fully staffed to make investment decisions.
evidence_needed: Internal Auditor's report on Investment Committee composition

requirement_text: The Investment Committee should report to Audit Committee of the Insurer.
mandatory_action: Establish a reporting mechanism from the Investment Committee to the Audit Committee.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the overall internal control system of the investment functions/ department of an insurer.
mandatory_action: Conduct an assessment of the internal control system for investment functions.
evidence_needed: Internal Auditor's report on internal control assessment

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the investment policy is in consonance with the IRDA Regulations and any deviation was reported to the Audit Committee/ Board of Directors.
mandatory_action: Verify compliance of the investment policy with IRDA Regulations and report any deviations.
evidence_needed: Internal Auditor's report on investment policy compliance
Records of deviations reported to Audit Committee/Board

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the correctness of segregation of Policy-holders fund and Share-holders fund to account the income earned on respective investments.
mandatory_action: Ensure proper segregation of Policy-holders and Share-holders funds in accounting.
evidence_needed: Internal Auditor's report on fund segregation

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the correctness of segregation of Policy-holders fund and Share-holders fund to account the income earned on respective investments.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the segregation of funds and the income accounting for each.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the Insurer, without prejudice to Sections 10 (2AA), 27, or 27B of the Insurance Act and any provisions of these regulations, invests and at all times keep invested its investment assets in the manner set out in the regulation 8.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that the Insurer complies with investment regulations as specified.

requirement_text: Such excess should be made after fully complying with investment in Central Government Securities, State Government and Other Approved Securities and in Housing & Infrastructure Investments from funds representing solvency margin.
mandatory_action: Ensure compliance with investment requirements for excess funds beyond the solvency margin.

requirement_text: Such excess of Shareholder‘s funds, held beyond Solvency Margin requirement, shall be held in a separate custody account with identified scrips.
mandatory_action: Maintain a separate custody account for excess shareholder funds beyond the solvency margin.

requirement_text: Such excess funds shall be determined only after Actuarial Valuation, certified by Appointed Actuary and such valuation is filed with the Authority.
mandatory_action: Conduct and file an actuarial valuation for excess funds with the Authority.

requirement_text: Such transfer made between quarters, should be certified by the Concurrent/ Internal Auditor to have complied with points (i), (ii) and (iii) above.
mandatory_action: Obtain certification from the Concurrent/Internal Auditor for transfers made between quarters.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that all investment in assets or instruments, which are capable of being rated as per market practice, should be made on the basis of credit rating of such assets or instruments.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure investments are based on credit ratings of rated assets or instruments.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should note that no approved investment shall be made in instruments, if such instruments are capable of being rated, but are not rated.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that no investments are made in unrated instruments that are capable of being rated.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that for investments, rating should be done by a credit rating agency registered under SEBI (Credit Rating Agencies) Regulations, 1999.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that ratings are conducted by SEBI-registered credit rating agencies.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check on the investments in Corporate bonds or debentures which should be rated not less than AA or its equivalent and A1 or equivalent ratings for short term bonds.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that corporate bonds or debentures meet the specified rating criteria.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check on the investments in Corporate bonds or debentures which should be rated not less than AA or its equivalent and A1 or equivalent ratings for short term bonds, debentures, certificate of deposit and commercial paper, by a credit rating agency, registered under SEBI (Credit Rating Agencies) Regulations, 1999
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that investments meet the specified credit ratings.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the rating of a debt instrument issued by All India Financial Institutions recognized as such by RBI shall be of ‘AA’ or equivalent rating.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure debt instruments have a rating of 'AA' or equivalent.

requirement_text: The Investment Committee may approve investments in instruments carrying current rating of not less than ‘A+’ or equivalent as rated by a credit rating agency, registered under SEBI (Credit Rating Agencies) Regulations, 1999, for the reasons to be recorded in the Investment Committee‘s minutes.
mandatory_action: The Investment Committee must document reasons for approving investments below 'AA' rating in their minutes.

requirement_text: It should be ensured that the Approved Investments under regulations 8 which are downgraded below the minimum rating prescribed or not.
mandatory_action: Ensure that approved investments do not fall below the minimum rating prescribed.

requirement_text: It should be ensured that the Approved Investments under regulations 8 which are downgraded below the minimum rating prescribed or not continuing to satisfy dividend criteria should be automatically re-classified under ‘Other Investments’ and specifically identified under a category which shall be valued at marked to market on a quarterly basis, for the purpose of pattern of investment.
mandatory_action: Ensure that downgraded Approved Investments are re-classified and valued quarterly.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should examine whether Investments in equity shares listed on a registered stock exchange should be made in actively traded and liquid instruments viz., equity shares other than those defined as thinly traded as per SEBI Regulations and guidelines governing mutual funds issued by SEBI from time to time.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must examine compliance with investment in actively traded and liquid equity shares.

requirement_text: Not less than 75per cent of investment in debt instruments (including Central Government Securities, State Government Securities or Other Approved Securities) in the case life insurer and not less than
mandatory_action: Ensure that at least 75% of investments in debt instruments are maintained as required.

requirement_text: not less than 65per cent of investment in debt instruments (including Central Government Securities, State Government Securities or Other Approved Securities) in the case of General Insurer including an insurer carrying on business of re-insurance or health insurance - shall be in sovereign debt, AAA or equivalent rating for long term and sovereign debt, A1+ or equivalent for short term instruments.
mandatory_action: General Insurers must ensure that at least 65% of their investment in debt instruments is in specified sovereign debt ratings.

requirement_text: Not more than 8 per cent of investment in debt instruments (including Central Government Securities, State Government Securities or Other Approved Securities) in the case of General Insurer including an insurer carrying on business of re-insurance or health insurance – shall have a rating of A or below or equivalent rating for long term
mandatory_action: Ensure that no more than 8% of investments in debt instruments have a rating of A or below.

requirement_text: Investments in debt instruments rated AA - (AA minus) or below for long term and below A1 or equivalent for short term debt instruments shall form part of Other Investments
mandatory_action: Classify investments in debt instruments rated AA- or below for long term and below A1 for short term as Other Investments.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the Insurer had formed an investment committee as specified.
mandatory_action: The Insurer must form an investment committee as specified.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the Investment Committee meet frequently to oversee the investment operations.
mandatory_action: The Investment Committee must meet frequently to oversee investment operations.

requirement_text: He should check whether the proceedings of the Investment Committee were recorded and minuted.
mandatory_action: The proceedings of the Investment Committee must be recorded and minuted.
evidence_needed: recorded minutes of Investment Committee meetings

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the back office, middle office front office functions and accounting functions were segregated by the insurer.
mandatory_action: The Insurer must segregate back office, middle office, front office, and accounting functions.

requirement_text: the insurer should check that these functions should not be outsourced.
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure that front office and accounting functions are not outsourced.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the decisions taken on investment or disinvestment with reasons were properly minuted.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that investment decisions are properly documented.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the appointment of dealers of investments for day to day operations.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the appointment of investment dealers.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check all the contracts on the sale/purchase of securities in the market from the dealers and ensure that only the ordered quantity of investments were purchased and sold.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must review contracts for securities transactions to confirm compliance with ordered quantities.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the reconciliation statement of investments transacted during the period (reconciliation to be done on the securities held by custodian with the contracts issued by the dealers) and ensure that all the investments traded were properly credited or debited by the custodian.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the reconciliation statements of investments against custodian records.

requirement_text: Internal Auditor should check that on the appointed day, whether the dealer/custodian had credited the sales realisation of investments with in the time limit.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm timely crediting of sales realizations by the dealer/custodian.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether proper risk management system was in place.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must assess the adequacy of the risk management system.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether proper risk management system was in place.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the existence of a proper risk management system.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that weekly projections of cash flow (both inward and outward) were prepared and investment and disinvestments were made accordingly.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that weekly cash flow projections are prepared and that investments and disinvestments align with these projections.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the insurer is a member of money-market operator and follow the RBI guidelines in this regard.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the insurer's membership with a money-market operator and compliance with RBI guidelines.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the money market transactions and the investment and disinvestment decisions for day to day operations.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must review money market transactions and daily investment and disinvestment decisions.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the dividend and interest credits and check whether they were credited on the due dates by the dealer or custodian as the case may be.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that dividend and interest credits were made on their due dates.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that matured investments were properly encashed and reinvested properly on the due date to avoid loss of interest.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that matured investments are encashed and reinvested on their due dates.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that matured investments were properly encashed and reinvested properly on the due date to avoid loss of interest.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the encashment and reinvestment of matured investments on the due date.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure whether at the time of investing, subject to group/ promoter group exposure norms, invest a maximum of 20per cent of the project cost (as decided by a competent body) of an Public Limited Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) engaged in infrastructure sector (or) amount under Regulation 9 (B) (i), whichever is lower, as a part of Approved Investments provided: a. such investment is in Debt
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm that investments in SPVs do not exceed the specified limits.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that Investment Committee should at least on a half-yearly periodicity evaluate the risk of such investments and take necessary corrective actions where the parent
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure the Investment Committee evaluates investment risks at least biannually and takes corrective actions as needed.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that Investment in securitized assets [Mortgaged Backed Securities (MBS) / Asset Backed Securities (ABS) / Security Receipts (SR)] both under approved and other investment category shall not exceed 5 per cent of Investment Asset in the case of General companies.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that investments in securitized assets do not exceed 5% of investment assets for General Insurance companies.

requirement_text: Any MBS / ABS with underlying housing or infrastructure assets, if downgraded below AAA or equivalent, shall be reclassified as Other Investments.
mandatory_action: MBS/ABS downgraded below AAA must be reclassified as Other Investments.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that Investment Property within the meaning of Accounting Standards, and covered under Regulation 3 (a)
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify compliance with Accounting Standards regarding Investment Property.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check that Investment Property within the meaning of Accounting Standards, and covered under Regulation 3 (a) (6) shall not exceed, at the time of investment, 5 per cent of Investment Assets in the case of general insurer held as ‘investment property’ should not be for ‘self-use’.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify compliance with the investment property limits and usage restrictions.

requirement_text: Immovable property, for self-use, should be purchased only out of share-holders funds, and should comply with circular / guidelines issued.
mandatory_action: Immovable property for self-use must be purchased from shareholders' funds and adhere to relevant guidelines.

requirement_text: an insurer should not have investments of more than 5per cent in aggregate of its investment assets in all companies belonging to the promoters‘ group.
mandatory_action: Insurers must limit their investments in promoters' group companies to no more than 5% of total investment assets.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure the exposure limit for financial and insurance activities should stand at 25per cent of investment assets for all insurers.
mandatory_action: Internal Auditors must verify that exposure limits for financial and insurance activities do not exceed 25% of investment assets.

requirement_text: Investment in Housing Financing Companies and Infrastructure Financing Companies (except investment in Bonds / debentures of HUDCO, NHB and only bonds issued by Housing Finance Companies having a rating of not less than AAA, and investment in Debt, Equity in dedicated infrastructure financing entities forming part of Infrastructure sector) shall form part of exposure to financial and insurance activities.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that their investments in specified companies comply with the outlined conditions.

requirement_text: Where an investment is in partly paid-up shares, the uncalled liability on such shares shall be added to the amount invested for the purpose of computing exposure norms.
mandatory_action: Insurers must include uncalled liabilities of partly paid-up shares in their exposure calculations.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that an insurer should not out of the controlled fund / assets invest or keep invested in the shares or debentures of any one company more than the exposure prescribed in Regulation 9 above.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must monitor and enforce investment limits as prescribed in Regulation 9.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the general cash management of the insurer.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must review the insurer's general cash management practices.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the investment of surplus funds in money/call markets were made after m
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the investment of surplus funds in money/call markets.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether the temporary surplus money was invested in money/call market and retrieved when required instead of selling dated securities or equities
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that temporary surplus funds are managed appropriately without resorting to selling dated securities or equities.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the decisions in investment in primary markets on equities and debts
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must review investment decisions in primary markets for equities and debts.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check whether there is any system with the Insurer to review the investments and categorise them into performing and non-performing.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the existence of a system for reviewing and categorizing investments.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the action taken to dispose of the non-performing investments to salvage them
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must assess the actions taken to dispose of non-performing investments.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the action taken to dispose of the non-performing investments to salvage them
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify actions taken on non-performing investments.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the Insurer did not invest in derivative trades markets (equity, interest rate, forex or other securities).
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm that no investments were made in derivative trades markets.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure whether all the transactions conducted by the front office got confirmed with the back office manager.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that all front office transactions are confirmed with the back office manager.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure whether the front office check the exposure limits prior to dealing with securities in secondary market.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure that exposure limits are checked by the front office before trading.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure whether the audit trail of new deals as well as deal amendments/cancellations were reviewed by an independent officer not connected with deal.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm that the audit trail of deals is reviewed by an independent officer.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the back office electronic accounting system supports full range of activities required for efficient processing of transactions, control and monitoring.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that the back office accounting system supports all necessary activities for transaction processing.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should ensure that the back office electronic accounting system supports full range of activities required for efficient processing of transactions, control and monitoring.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must ensure the back office electronic accounting system is capable of supporting all necessary activities for transaction processing and control.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the dynamism of the updation of data base after every transaction to ensure that it provides exact quantum of exposure under each category of investment.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify that the database is updated dynamically after each transaction to reflect accurate exposure levels.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify whether all the controls and monitoring reports are gone through by the management.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must confirm that management reviews all controls and monitoring reports.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should track the exception reports and investigate the reasons.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must track exception reports and conduct investigations into their causes.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should verify the risk management system in the investment department
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must verify the risk management system in the investment department.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should check the sufficiency and effectiveness of the MIS system.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must check the sufficiency and effectiveness of the MIS system.

requirement_text: It is the duty of the Auditor to know about the functioning of the organisation in which he is going to conduct audit.
mandatory_action: Auditors must understand the organization's functioning before conducting an audit.

requirement_text: It is the duty of the auditor to collect the required data from the organisation before commencement of any audit.
mandatory_action: Auditors must collect necessary data prior to starting an audit.

requirement_text: it is the duty of the auditor to collect the required data from the organisation.
mandatory_action: The auditor must collect the required data from the organization before commencing any audit.

requirement_text: The audit program should be got approved from the appointing authority.
mandatory_action: The internal auditor must obtain approval for the annual audit program from the appointing authority.

requirement_text: The Auditor should, as already mentioned above, communicate his audit program in advance to the respective head of department to enable him to keep all the documents / records ready for audit.
mandatory_action: The internal auditor must communicate the audit program in advance to the respective head of department.

requirement_text: communicate his audit program in advance to the respective head of department to enable him to keep all the documents / records ready for audit.
mandatory_action: The auditor must communicate the audit program in advance to the respective head of department.

requirement_text: Auditor should make an entry meeting with the concerned key personnel of the department/unit to understand their functioning, their short-comings etc.
mandatory_action: The auditor must conduct an entry meeting with key personnel to understand departmental functioning and shortcomings.

requirement_text: The Internal Auditor should prepare a detailed check list for audit.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must prepare a detailed checklist for the audit.

requirement_text: All his preliminary audit findings should be addressed to the respective key personnel and their views should be recorded before drafting the audit findings of the department.
mandatory_action: Preliminary audit findings must be addressed to key personnel, and their views recorded before drafting final findings.

requirement_text: At the end of each audit, a comprehensive draft report to be prepared and discussed with the HOD/key personnel and their views should be considered before preparation of the final report relating to the department.
mandatory_action: A comprehensive draft report must be prepared and discussed with HOD/key personnel, considering their views before finalizing the report.

requirement_text: For each meeting, the minutes to be drawn and both auditor and the key personnel to be signed.
mandatory_action: Minutes of each meeting must be documented and signed by both the auditor and key personnel.

requirement_text: the minutes to be drawn and both auditor and the key personnel to be signed and documented.
mandatory_action: Minutes of each meeting must be drawn and signed by the auditor and key personnel.
evidence_needed: signatures of auditor and key personnel

requirement_text: All the audit findings should be well supported by documents and they should be properly arranged.
mandatory_action: Audit findings must be supported by documents and arranged properly.

requirement_text: Each stage of audit should be documented.
mandatory_action: All stages of the audit must be documented.

requirement_text: There should be proper authorisation from the IT administrator to the Internal Auditor for the specified data access to conduct audit.
mandatory_action: Obtain proper authorization from the IT administrator for data access by the Internal Auditor.

requirement_text: An auditor should document the process of audit properly in an orderly manner.
mandatory_action: The audit process must be documented in an orderly manner by the auditor.

requirement_text: the proper documentation of audit findings well supported by documentation and filing.
mandatory_action: Ensure proper documentation and filing of audit findings.

requirement_text: The Internal Audit team should have proper working papers and evidences to support their audit findings.
mandatory_action: The Internal Audit team must maintain proper working papers and evidence for audit findings.

requirement_text: It is the duty of the auditor to report all his findings in an orderly manner.
mandatory_action: The auditor must report all findings in an orderly manner.

requirement_text: The report should incorporate the views of the respective controlling authority i.e. CEO or top Management/Board of Directors or Audit Committee in case of big organisations.
mandatory_action: The audit report must include the views of the controlling authority.

requirement_text: The final audit report should be finalised within a time frame of say one week after completion of audit.
mandatory_action: Finalize the audit report within one week after the audit completion.

requirement_text: Each audit report should be signed by the Internal Audit.
mandatory_action: Ensure each audit report is signed by the Internal Audit.

requirement_text: After preparation of the report, the same should be issued to the Management for their view.
mandatory_action: Issue the audit report to Management for their feedback after preparation.

requirement_text: After incorporating the views of the Management, the final report be submitted to the Audit Committee for their consideration and recommendations.
mandatory_action: Submit the final report to the Audit Committee after incorporating Management's views.

requirement_text: the final report be submitted to the Audit Committee for their consideration and recommendations.
mandatory_action: The final audit report must be submitted to the Audit Committee.

requirement_text: the Internal Auditor should give an assurance that he had verified all the items required as per law and regulations.
mandatory_action: The Internal Auditor must provide assurance of compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements in the audit report.
