requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that the premium and compensation structure for intermediaries are consistent between products of similar features/duration and distribution channels so as to minimise possible lapse and re-entry or churning, and channel conflicts.
mandatory_action: The insurer must maintain consistent premium and compensation structures for intermediaries across similar products.

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that the product proposals include the following information to assist the Board or senior management in making informed decisions: scope and level of coverage proposed for the product including options and guarantees, if any; risk exposure limits; reinsurance protection; pricing methodology.
mandatory_action: The insurer must include specified information in product proposals to aid decision-making by the Board or senior management.
evidence_needed: documentation of coverage and risk exposure limits

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that the potential risks identified in section 3.2.3 are adequately addressed under a risk management framework that would cover the key issues when introducing a new product.
mandatory_action: Insurers must address potential risks under a risk management framework when introducing new products.

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that there is proper documentation of the detailed product proposal, the product approval authority levels, the decisions made by the authorised personnel or committee as well as the rationale and follow-up actions.
mandatory_action: Insurers must document the detailed product proposal and related approval processes.

requirement_text: when a decision has been made by the appropriate approval authority to accept a proposal which does not meet the risk tolerance or profit objectives of the insurer, the approval and rationale for such a decision should be clearly documented.
mandatory_action: Insurers must document approvals and rationales for proposals that do not meet risk tolerance or profit objectives.

requirement_text: The insurer should have clearly articulated procedures for withdrawal and re-pricing of existing products when pre-determined criteria
mandatory_action: Insurers must establish procedures for product withdrawal and re-pricing based on pre-determined criteria.

requirement_text: The insurer should have clearly articulated procedures for withdrawal and re-pricing of existing products when pre-determined criteria are triggered, such as when it is no longer economically viable to sell the product.
mandatory_action: The insurer must establish and document procedures for product withdrawal and re-pricing based on specific criteria.
evidence_needed: documented procedures for withdrawal and re-pricing

requirement_text: An insurer should put in place a structure setting out the reporting lines and roles of business units and personnel involved, and procedures and risk indicators to monitor the product implementation and performance after its launch.
mandatory_action: The insurer must establish a reporting structure and procedures for monitoring product implementation and performance.

requirement_text: monitoring adherence to the insurer’s policies and procedures as well as regulatory requirements;
mandatory_action: Insurers must monitor adherence to their policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

requirement_text: conducting internal audit reviews and actuarial reviews.
mandatory_action: Insurers must conduct internal audit reviews and actuarial reviews.

requirement_text: An insurer should identify the probable scenarios which may lead to its revenue from premiums and investment income being insufficient to meet the payment of anticipated benefits and expenses (including cost of capital and taxes).
mandatory_action: Insurers must identify probable scenarios affecting revenue sufficiency.

requirement_text: An insurer should collect adequate data to validate the reasonableness of the underlying assumptions used for deriving the base rate of the product.
mandatory_action: Insurers must collect adequate data to validate assumptions for the base rate of products.

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that the assumptions chosen to derive the base rate are appropriate, after considering the internal and external experience studies and the financial impact of sensitivity testing of each of the assumptions.
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure the appropriateness of assumptions used for base rate derivation.

requirement_text: Assumptions with significant financial impact (“financially significant assumptions”) should be monitored more frequently and comprehensively than non-financially significant assumptions.
mandatory_action: The insurer must monitor financially significant assumptions more frequently and comprehensively.

requirement_text: Where the insurer has no or little past experience data, it should monitor the assumptions.
mandatory_action: The insurer must monitor assumptions when there is little or no past experience data.

requirement_text: The insurer should also have adequate buffers in the premiums to cushion against the risk that actual experience may turn out to be worse than expected.
mandatory_action: Insurers must maintain adequate buffers in premiums to mitigate risks of adverse actual experience.

requirement_text: Pricing should be done by modelling all identified risks, using appropriate methodologies depending on the complexity of the risks and available data.
mandatory_action: Insurers must model all identified risks using suitable methodologies for pricing.

requirement_text: For complex benefit structures such as embedded options, an insurer should evaluate the risk arising from such options through stochastic modelling and stress testing.
mandatory_action: Insurers must evaluate risks from complex benefit structures using stochastic modelling and stress testing.

requirement_text: The insurer should evaluate the risk arising from such options through stochastic modelling and stress testing.
mandatory_action: Insurers must evaluate risks using stochastic modelling and stress testing.

requirement_text: The insurer should not restrict itself to using only a single pricing methodology.
mandatory_action: Insurers must use multiple pricing methodologies for risk evaluation.

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that there is clear documentation that the base rate has been approved at the requisite level of authority.
mandatory_action: Insurers must document the approval of the base rate at the required authority level.

requirement_text: Should the insurer decide to quote a premium rate that deviates significantly from the base rate, it should ensure that appropriate authorisation is obtained and proper documentation of the approval is maintained.
mandatory_action: Insurers must obtain appropriate authorisation and maintain documentation when quoting a premium rate that deviates significantly from the base rate.

requirement_text: There should be procedures in place to monitor emerging trends and changes to the external environment, and risk indicators to trigger a pricing review when there are indications that the insurer’s objectives are not likely to be achieved.
mandatory_action: Insurers must establish procedures to monitor trends and risk indicators for pricing reviews.

requirement_text: The insurer should also monitor deviations of the final rate from the base rate and review the actual results against the anticipated benefits and expenses that have been factored into the computation of the base rate to improve on future pricing.
mandatory_action: Insurers must monitor rate deviations and review actual results against anticipated benefits and expenses for future pricing improvements.

requirement_text: The insurer should involve actuaries in the evaluation and provision of advice on product pricing and development matters.
mandatory_action: Insurers must involve actuaries in product pricing and development evaluations.

requirement_text: An insurer should consider the implications associated with selecting, accepting and retaining risks which may deviate from what was envisaged during the product development and pricing stages.
mandatory_action: Insurers must consider the implications of selecting, accepting, and retaining risks that deviate from initial expectations during product development.

requirement_text: An insurer should ensure that the proposal or application form is reviewed regularly to ensure that the questions remain reasonably clear and pertinent.
mandatory_action: Insurers must regularly review the proposal or application form for clarity and relevance.

requirement_text: It is also important to remind policyholders and the intermediaries of the need to keep the insurer informed of material changes in underwriting information for yearly renewable policies where variable premiums are determined during the annual underwriting process.
mandatory_action: Insurers must remind policyholders and intermediaries to report material changes in underwriting information.

requirement_text: An insurer should ensure that the proposal or application form is duly completed and the information relied on are relevant, current and unambiguous in order for the underwriters to form an accurate assessment of the risks to be insured and to better identify emerging risks.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure that proposal or application forms are completed accurately and contain relevant, current, and unambiguous information.

requirement_text: The insurer should have an efficient insurance information system in place that links all key information on underwriting, claims and reinsurance, preferably on the same electronic platform.
mandatory_action: Insurers must implement an efficient insurance information system that integrates key information on underwriting, claims, and reinsurance.

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that the information captured in the insurance information system, including the rationale for the underwriting decision, is up-to-date and accurate to facilitate monitoring of the progress of the underwriting process and validating the quality of the underwriting decision.
mandatory_action: The insurer must maintain up-to-date and accurate information in the insurance information system.

requirement_text: The insurer should have clearly documented underwriting guidelines for each of the key types of benefits or products it underwrites.
mandatory_action: The insurer must document underwriting guidelines for all key benefits or products.

requirement_text: Senior management should approve the policy for granting discounts on premium rates.
mandatory_action: Senior management must approve the discount policy for premium rates.

requirement_text: Senior management should approve the policy for granting discounts on premium rates, have clear delegation of the authority to grant the discounts, and review the policy and delegation arrangement regularly.
mandatory_action: Senior management must approve and regularly review the discount policy and delegation of authority.

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that any significant deviation of the underwriting decision from the guidelines should be duly approved and the rationale for approval properly documented.
mandatory_action: Any significant deviation in underwriting decisions must be approved and documented.

requirement_text: No risks should be accepted before the necessary reinsurance protection is finalised and effected.
mandatory_action: Reinsurance protection must be finalized before accepting any risks.

requirement_text: An insurer should conduct regular reviews to ensure that the underwriters continue to be competent in the area of their delegated authority and the quality of the underwriting decisions made remains satisfactory.
mandatory_action: Regular reviews of underwriter competence and decision quality must be conducted.

requirement_text: The insurer should have a systematic method to monitor its accumulation of risks across product types and geographical areas.
mandatory_action: A systematic method for monitoring risk accumulation must be established.

requirement_text: The insurer should have a systematic method to monitor its accumulation of risks across product types and geographical areas so that the overall risks underwritten by the insurer are always within its reinsurance protection limits and risk appetite.
mandatory_action: The insurer must implement a systematic method to monitor risk accumulation.

requirement_text: The insurer should conduct audits or checks of underwriting files regularly.
mandatory_action: The insurer must conduct regular audits or checks of underwriting files.

requirement_text: There should also be an appropriate system to select the files to be reviewed.
mandatory_action: The insurer must establish a system for selecting files for review.

requirement_text: The insurer should monitor risk indicators like claims experience.
mandatory_action: The insurer must monitor risk indicators such as claims experience.

requirement_text: An insurer should put in place measures to identify the risks associated with poor claims handling and case reserving.
mandatory_action: Insurers must implement measures to identify risks related to claims handling and case reserving.

requirement_text: An insurer should have a clear process in place for the notification of claims by the intermediaries or the policyholders.
mandatory_action: Insurers must establish a clear claims notification process for intermediaries and policyholders.

requirement_text: The insurer should review the claims form regularly to ensure that questions remain reasonably clear, unambiguous and pertinent to enable the claims staff to form an accurate assessment of the validity of the claim.
mandatory_action: The insurer must regularly review the claims form for clarity and relevance.
evidence_needed: review logs of claims form updates
meeting minutes discussing claims form reviews

requirement_text: The insurer should have an efficient information system in place as elaborated in paragraph 3.4.4.3.
mandatory_action: The insurer must implement an efficient information system for claims management.

requirement_text: The insurer should also have clearly documented claims handling guidelines for each of the key types of claims to provide sufficient guidance to the claims staff.
mandatory_action: The insurer must document claims handling guidelines for key claim types.

requirement_text: The claims handling guidelines should be regularly reviewed and updated to factor in new developments and trends.
mandatory_action: The insurer must regularly review and update the claims handling guidelines.

requirement_text: The insurer should have a clear control process for the payment of large claims, for example, getting an official sign-off from a member of the management team and the reinsurer, where applicable.
mandatory_action: The insurer must implement a clear control process for large claims payments that includes official sign-off.

requirement_text: The insurer should endeavour to set case reserves accurately for each claim in a timely manner, especially in respect of general insurance business.
mandatory_action: The insurer must set case reserves accurately and timely for each claim.

requirement_text: The insurer should have a clear policy, approved by senior management, with regards to ex-gratia claim payments.
mandatory_action: The insurer must establish and obtain approval for a policy on ex-gratia claim payments.

requirement_text: The authority to approve such payments should also be clearly specified and the rationale for the approval should be properly documented.
mandatory_action: The insurer must specify the authority for approving ex-gratia payments and document the rationale for approvals.

requirement_text: An insurer should conduct regular reviews to ensure that the claims assessors continue to be competent in their area of delegated authority.
mandatory_action: The insurer must conduct regular reviews of claims assessors' competence.

requirement_text: An insurer should conduct regular reviews to ensure that the claims assessors continue to be competent in their area of delegated authority and quality of the claims decisions made remains satisfactory.
mandatory_action: Insurers should conduct regular reviews of claims assessors' competence and claims decision quality.

requirement_text: The insurer should conduct reviews of claim files regularly.
mandatory_action: The insurer must conduct regular reviews of claim files.

requirement_text: There should also be a systematic way to identify files for review and clear guidelines for follow-up actions and closure of files.
mandatory_action: The insurer must establish a systematic process for identifying files for review and guidelines for follow-up actions.

requirement_text: The insurer should perform quality reviews of claims to assess whether they are handled professionally and resolved appropriately.
mandatory_action: The insurer must perform quality reviews of claims to ensure professional handling and appropriate resolution.

requirement_text: The insurer should have in place regular claims reporting to senior management so as to raise awareness of key claim exposures and losses, especially where a single claim, loss event or series of losses could in aggregate have an impact on its balance sheet.
mandatory_action: Insurers must implement regular claims reporting to senior management.

requirement_text: An insurer should analyse its risk profile in conjunction with the legal, economic, social and political environment in which it operates.
mandatory_action: Insurers must analyze their risk profile considering the external environment.

requirement_text: The insurer has to decide what and how much risks to retain taking into consideration its risk appetite, and the availability and cost of reinsurance.
mandatory_action: Insurers must determine their risk retention levels based on risk appetite and reinsurance factors.

requirement_text: It should identify the source and magnitude of concentration of risks and assess the impact of likely adverse events.
mandatory_action: Insurers must identify risk concentration sources and assess potential adverse event impacts.

requirement_text: It also has to be mindful of possible gaps in the reinsurance programme, resulting in more risks being retained than intended.
mandatory_action: Insurers must monitor for gaps in their reinsurance programs to avoid unintended risk retention.

requirement_text: An insurer’s risk tolerance level should be clearly defined so that the Board and senior management will be able to assess the expected maximum impact of one or more major catastrophes on the financial position of the insurer.
mandatory_action: The insurer must define and review its risk tolerance level.

requirement_text: The insurer’s risk tolerance level should be reviewed by senior management annually and approved by the Board.
mandatory_action: The insurer must review and obtain Board approval for its risk tolerance level annually.

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that its reinsurance contracts cover all applicable lines of business and the limits of cover are adequate.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure reinsurance contracts adequately cover all lines of business.

requirement_text: The terms, conditions and exclusions stipulated in the reinsurance contracts should also be aligned with those of the underlying business.
mandatory_action: Insurers must align reinsurance contract terms with the underlying business.

requirement_text: The insurer should also assess the impact of likely adverse events through stress testing and realistic disaster scenario analysis to ensure that its catastrophe reinsurance cover.
mandatory_action: Insurers must conduct stress testing and disaster scenario analysis for catastrophe reinsurance cover.

requirement_text: The insurer should not adopt a “deal now, detail later” philosophy as lack of contract certainty could lead to potential legal disputes and unintended assumption of liabilities.
mandatory_action: The insurer must avoid a 'deal now, detail later' approach to ensure contract certainty.

requirement_text: It should put in place appropriate systems and processes to facilitate achieving contract certainty, including prompt commencement of review of the reinsurance programme and vetting of contract wordings.
mandatory_action: The insurer must implement systems and processes to achieve contract certainty and review the reinsurance programme promptly.

requirement_text: The reinsurance management guidelines should spell out clear criteria for the selection of reinsurers and outline the information that is.
mandatory_action: The insurer must ensure that reinsurance management guidelines include clear criteria for selecting reinsurers.

requirement_text: The insurer should maintain an up-to-date list of reinsurers that meet its criteria and the appropriate level of exposure for each approved reinsurer or group of related reinsurers.
mandatory_action: The insurer must maintain an updated list of approved reinsurers and their exposure levels.

requirement_text: there should be clear guidance on the follow-up actions required.
mandatory_action: Insurers must establish clear guidance for follow-up actions when a reinsurer no longer meets criteria.

requirement_text: it should satisfy itself that the advice given is sound.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure the soundness of advice received from reinsurance brokers regarding the reinsurance program.

requirement_text: It should always maintain sufficient oversight and control over the design and placement of its reinsurance programme.
mandatory_action: Insurers must maintain sufficient oversight and control over their reinsurance program design and placement.

requirement_text: The insurer should render reinsurance statements and perform reconciliation of accounts regularly and promptly.
mandatory_action: Insurers must regularly and promptly render reinsurance statements and perform account reconciliations.

requirement_text: The insurer should render reinsurance statements and perform reconciliation of accounts regularly and promptly as failure to do so may cause balances due from reinsurers to build up or result in disputes over the outstanding balances, thereby increasing credit/asset risk.
mandatory_action: Insurers must render reinsurance statements and perform account reconciliations regularly and promptly.

requirement_text: The insurer should ensure that there is good communication between the different business units in the institution to facilitate early identification of any potential liquidity strain, such as large claims triggering cash calls to reinsurers.
mandatory_action: Insurers must ensure good communication between business units to identify potential liquidity strains early.

requirement_text: An insurer should monitor that only approved reinsurers are used and track aggregate exposures to individual reinsurers or groups of related reinsurers against exposure limits established.
mandatory_action: Insurers must monitor the use of only approved reinsurers and track aggregate exposures against established limits.

requirement_text: The insurer should also review whether its reinsurance programme has, over a period of time, supported its business objectives and strategies, and helped to mitigate its losses to within its risk tolerance level.
mandatory_action: The insurer must review its reinsurance programme regularly to ensure it aligns with business objectives and risk tolerance.
